i: Nuts (as a snack with tea) - 8 pcs
p: Chop the tomato and bell pepper into small pieces.
Lightly sauté the vegetables in a non-stick pan (without oil or with a drop if needed).
Beat the egg whites and yolk together, add salt and pepper to taste.
Pour the egg mixture into the pan with the vegetables and cook on medium heat for about 5 minutes.
You can enjoy a cup of tea and 8 nuts during the day as desired.

i: Pasta (orzo or other small pasta) - 80 g
Fresh herbs, salt, pepper - to taste
p: Heat a pan and lightly grease it with oil.
Slice the garlic and halve the cherry tomatoes. Sauté them in the pan.
Cook the pasta 2 minutes less than the package instructions.
Cut the chicken into small cubes. Add it to the pan with tomatoes, along with fresh spinach and tomato paste. Simmer for about 10 minutes, until the chicken is fully cooked.
Add the grated cheese, cream, seasonings, salt, and the partially cooked pasta.
Cook for another 3-4 minutes on low heat, until the cheese melts and the sauce thickens.
After the meal
1 fruit (e.g., apple)

i: Salad mix or fresh spinach - 2 handfuls
Salt, pepper, spices (e.g. paprika or dried basil) - to taste
Pine nuts or sesame seeds - 1 tsp (optional)
p: If using raw shrimp, cook them in a pan for 2-3 minutes per side until pink and cooked through. Let them cool slightly.
In a large bowl, combine the salad mix (or spinach), halved cherry tomatoes, sliced cucumber, avocado, and chopped red onion (if using).
In a small bowl, mix olive oil, lemon or lime juice, minced garlic, salt, pepper, and your favorite spices to make the dressing.
Add the cooked shrimp to the salad, pour the dressing over the top, and gently toss everything together.
Sprinkle with pine nuts or sesame seeds if desired.
Tip
Prepare a double portion to save time - store the second serving in an airtight container in the fridge for the next day. Keep the dressing separate until serving, if possible

recipes.t: Avocado Toast with Salmon and Poached Egg
i: A pinch of dried nori or fresh herbs
p: Peel and mash the avocado with a fork.
Add lemon juice, salt, and pepper; mix well.
Bring water to a boil in a pot, then reduce to a gentle simmer.
Add the vinegar, stir the water to create a whirlpool, and gently drop in the egg.
Cook for 3-4 minutes, then remove with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel.
Toast the bread in a toaster or on a pan until golden.
Spread the mashed avocado on the toast, add slices of salmon, and top with the poached egg.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds, nori, or fresh herbs.
After breakfast
Green Tea

recipes.t: Oatmeal with Chia Pudding, Banana, and Berries
p: Prepare the chia pudding: Mix chia seeds with yogurt and 1 tsp of honey.
Let it sit in the fridge for 2-3 hours or overnight to thicken.
Cook the oatmeal: Boil the oats in water until soft (about 5-7 minutes).
Place the oatmeal in a bowl and top with chia pudding.
Slice the banana and place on top.
Add the berries and, optionally, a little more honey or some nuts.
Green tea

recipes.t: Baked Chicken Breast with Couscous and Fresh Greens
i: Paprika, ground pepper, salt - to taste
p: Rub the chicken fillet with paprika, salt, and pepper. Wrap it in foil and bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 30-40 minutes. Then slice the chicken.
Cook the couscous according to package instructions. Season it with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
On a plate, arrange the couscous, sliced chicken breast, mixed greens, and halved cherry tomatoes.
Cook the rice until tender.
Prepare the beef: Slice the beef into thin strips. Season with salt, pepper, and add soy sauce (if using). Let it marinate for 10-15 minutes.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until golden, then remove the garlic to avoid burning.
Add the beef to the pan and fry for about 5 minutes until browned on all sides. Remove the beef from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add asparagus and cook for about 5-10 minutes until tender but still crisp.
Return the beef to the pan, mix well, and heat through for another 1-2 minutes.
Serve the beef and asparagus over the cooked rice.

recipes.t: Rice Salad with Asparagus and Veggies
i: Salt, ground black pepper - to taste
A handful of lettuce or spinach
Lemon juice or balsamic vinegar - optional, for dressing
p: Cook the rice until tender. Let it cool slightly.
Wash and chop the asparagus. Sauté in olive oil with minced garlic for 5-7 minutes, until tender-crisp. Season with a bit of salt.
Chop all other vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
In a large bowl, combine the rice, asparagus, and vegetables. Add a splash of soy sauce and optionally lemon juice or balsamic vinegar.
Toss everything together and serve warm or chilled.

recipes.t: Baked Potatoes with Zucchini and Mushrooms
i: 100 g mushrooms (e.g., white button or cremini)
60 g onion (about 1/2 of a small onion)
2 tbsp Greek yogurt (2%) - optional, for serving
Spices - paprika, rosemary, thyme - to taste
p: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Wash and peel the potatoes, then cut them into small cubes or wedges.
Chop the zucchini and mushrooms into bite-sized pieces.
Finely chop the onion and garlic.
In a large bowl, combine all vegetables with olive oil, garlic, onion, salt, pepper, and your preferred spices.
Spread the mixture evenly on a baking tray lined with parchment paper or lightly greased.
Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden and cooked through.
Optionally, serve with 1 tbsp of Greek yogurt per portion and sprinkle with fresh chopped herbs like parsley or dill.
Wash the spinach and apple.
Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
If too thick, add more water or almond milk and blend again.
Pour into two glasses and enjoy!

i: (or 4 boiled eggs if you prefer a meat-free version)
200 g salad mix (romaine, iceberg, or other leafy greens)
p: Cook the chicken
Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a pan and cook the chicken for about 5-7 minutes on each side, until fully cooked. Slice into thin strips.
(Alternatively, boil the eggs for 8-10 minutes, peel, and slice or quarter them.)
Prepare the dressing
In a bowl, combine the Greek yogurt, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, and optional garlic. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Assemble the salad
In a large bowl, add the salad mix and halved cherry tomatoes. Top with either the sliced chicken or boiled eggs.
Drizzle with dressing, sprinkle with grated Parmesan, and toss gently before serving.

i: Oat flour - 100 g (or blended rolled oats)
Berries (blueberries, strawberries, raspberries) - 50-100 g (Instead of berries, you can use mango puree - it adds natural sweetness and a tropical twist.)
Coconut oil or other for frying - 1 tsp
p: Blend banana, egg, and milk until smooth.
Add oat flour and baking powder, mix until you get a smooth batter.
Heat a pan and lightly grease with coconut oil. Pour small portions of batter and cook over medium heat for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Serve the pancakes with berries on top. Optionally, drizzle with natural yogurt or honey.
Portion: 3-4 pancakes
Calories: 240-280 kcal
Tea

i: Lettuce or spinach - 2 handfuls per portion
Fresh herbs (basil or parsley) - to taste
Soy sauce or lemon juice - 1 tbsp
Spices (garlic powder, paprika, black pepper) - to taste
p: Cook the quinoa (or bulgur)
Rinse and boil in 2 parts water for about 15 minutes. Let it cool.
Prep the veggies
Halve the cherry tomatoes.
Slice the celery.
Cut zucchini into ribbons (raw or lightly blanched).
Wash and dry lettuce and herbs.
Prepare the tofu
Cut into cubes, marinate in olive oil, soy sauce, and spices for 10-15 minutes.
Then pan-fry until golden or bake at 180°C for ~15 minutes.
Assemble the bowl
In each bowl or container, layer
quinoa greens veggies tofu herbs.
Add dressing
Use leftover marinade or make a simple dressing with olive oil, lemon juice, and mustard (optional)

recipes.t: Roasted Sweet Potato and Asparagus with Parmesan
p: Prepare the vegetables
Wash and peel the sweet potato, then cut it into chunks or half-moons (not too thick).
Trim the tough ends off the asparagus. Leave whole or cut in half.
Make the dressing
In a small bowl, mix olive oil with garlic, salt, pepper, and lemon juice if using.
Roasting
Spread the sweet potato on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper or lightly oiled.
Roast in a 200°C oven for about 15 minutes.
Add the asparagus, drizzle with the remaining oil mixture, and roast for another 10-12 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
Add Parmesan
In the last 2 minutes, sprinkle the vegetables with grated Parmesan and return to the oven until melted and slightly golden.
Prepare the vegetables: Slice or dice the tomato, cucumber, and bell pepper.
Mix the herbs and cheese: Finely chop the dill and parsley, then mash them together with the feta using a fork.
Spread the yogurt or a light sauce over the flatbread.
Assemble: Place lettuce on the flatbread, then add the vegetables, and top with the cheese mixture.
Wrap it up: Roll the flatbread into a wrap or fold it into an envelope.
Optional: Toast in a dry pan or grill until crispy and golden.
After breakfast
Tea with 7-9 nuts (e.g. almonds or walnuts)

i: Egg - 1 small (or use half of a large one)
Flour - a little, for coating only
p: Prepare the batter
(Optional) Press the cottage cheese through a sieve for a smoother texture.
Add the egg, sugar, salt, and vanilla sugar. Mix well.
Stir in the semolina and let the mixture rest for 10-15 minutes to thicken.
Shape the pancakes
Lightly wet or oil your hands.
Divide the mixture into 4-6 portions, roll into balls, and flatten into small pancakes.
Coat each piece lightly with flour.
Fry
Heat a non-stick pan with a small amount of oil over medium heat.
Fry the pancakes for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden and cooked through.
Serve warm with fresh fruit (50grams) and tea.

i: Paella rice or short-grain rice - 125 g
Saffron threads or turmeric - a pinch
p: Prepare the vegetables
Finely chop the onion.
Mince the garlic.
Slice the bell pepper into strips.
Dice or julienne the carrot.
Cut green beans into 2 cm (about 1 inch) pieces.
Sauté
Heat the olive oil in a wide pan or paella pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic, sauté until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add carrot, bell pepper, and green beans, cook for another 5 minutes.
Add rice and spices
Stir in the rice and paprika, coating the rice well with oil and spices.
Pour in the vegetable broth or water, add saffron or turmeric, salt, and pepper.
Cook the paella
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low.
Cook uncovered without stirring until the rice absorbs the liquid and is tender, about 15-20 minutes.
About 5 minutes before done, add the grated or chopped tomatoes gently on top and mix lightly.
Serve
Remove from heat, cover with a clean towel, and let rest for 5 minutes.
Serve with lemon wedges.

i: Canned tuna in its own juice - 1 can (about 150-180 g)
Mixed greens (arugula, spinach, lettuce, watercress) - 1-2 handfuls
p: Wash and dice the cucumber and tomatoes.
Thinly slice the red onion.
Rinse and dry the mixed greens well.
Open the tuna, drain the liquid, and flake the tuna with a fork.
In a large bowl, combine the vegetables, mixed greens, and tuna.
Dress with olive oil and lemon juice, then season with salt and pepper to taste.
Add fresh herbs if desired and gently toss everything together.

i: 2 slices of jamón or cured salmon
50 g of baked beans in tomato sauce
p: Omelette
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt. Fry in a preheated pan with some butter until cooked.
Toast
Warm up or toast the bread slices in a pan.
Avocado
Slice the avocado.
Tomato
Cut the tomato in half and lightly fry it on both sides.
Beans
Heat the baked beans in a small pot or in the microwave.
Serve with tea and 1 piece of fruit (e.g., melon).
Chop the vegetables into small pieces and sauté them in a non-stick pan.
Whisk the eggs and egg whites together, add salt and pepper to taste.
Pour the egg mixture into the pan with the vegetables and cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes.
Extras
Tea + nuts (8 pieces)

i: Whole grain / chickpea / durum wheat pasta - 120 g (dry weight)
Hard cheese (e.g., light Parmesan or Grana Padano) - 30-40 g, grated
Turkey breast or lean ham - 60-80 g, diced
Salt and black pepper - to taste
p: Cook the pasta until al dente. Reserve a few tablespoons of the pasta water.
In a non-stick pan, sauté the turkey or ham (and garlic if using) until lightly golden.
In a bowl, whisk together the whole egg, egg whites, and grated cheese. Add black pepper to taste.
Add the cooked pasta to the pan, remove from heat, and pour in the egg mixture. Mix quickly and thoroughly to create a creamy texture. Add a bit of reserved pasta water if needed.
Serve immediately, garnished with herbs, extra cheese, or black pepper if desired.

i: Cooked beans (kidney beans, chickpeas, or white beans) - 200 g
Spices to taste (salt, pepper, coriander, paprika, bay leaf)
p: Wash and chop the carrot and onion. Sauté in a pan with 1 tsp olive oil until soft.
Add the braised cabbage and cook for 15-20 minutes over medium heat, adding a little water if needed.
Add the cooked beans, salt and pepper to taste, and the spices.
Simmer together for another 5-10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve warm.

i: Cooked beans (chickpeas, white or red beans) - 200 g
Spices to taste: salt, pepper, paprika, oregano or cumin
Water - 2-3 tbsp (for cooking instead of oil)
p: Dice all the vegetables.
In a non-stick pan, add a bit of water and lightly sauté the onion, garlic, and carrot until soft.
Add the eggplant and bell pepper. Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally and adding more water if needed.
Add the chopped tomato and spices. Cover and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Stir in the cooked beans and simmer for another 5 minutes.
Serve warm.

i: Milk or water - 240 ml (you can use plant-based milk like almond, oat, or coconut)
Honey or maple syrup - optional, 1 teaspoon
p: In a small pot, bring the milk or water to a boil.
Add the oats and a pinch of salt. Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally until the oats are soft and creamy.
Remove from heat. Add honey or syrup if desired.
Pour the oatmeal into a bowl.
Top with
Sliced banana
Sliced strawberries
Fresh raspberries and blueberries
Optionally, sprinkle with chia seeds, nuts, or shredded coconut.

i: 70 g canned tuna in its own juice (drained) (or 1/2 avocado - as a vegetarian option)
30 g soft cheese (like spreadable or shredded cheese)
p: Hard-boil the egg and chop it finely.
Drain the tuna and break it into small chunks with a fork.
Dice the cucumber and tomato. Chop fresh dill if using.
Spread cream cheese over one side of the lavash.
Layer with lettuce leaves.
Add chopped egg, tuna, cucumber, and tomato.
Sprinkle with dill and season with pepper to taste.
Fold the top and bottom edges inward, then roll into a tight wrap.
Toast in a dry, preheated pan for 2 minutes on each side, pressing lightly.
Serve with
Hot tea and a few nuts on the side

recipes.t: Herb-Roasted Potatoes with Cherry Tomatoes & Cheese
i: Hard cheese (e.g. parmesan, gouda, gruyère) - 50-60 g
Garlic powder or 1 garlic clove - optional
p: Prepare the potatoes
Wash them (no need to peel), and cut into wedges. Place them on a baking tray lined with parchment paper.
Season
Drizzle with olive oil, then sprinkle with salt, pepper, dried herbs, and garlic (if using). Toss to coat evenly.
Bake - Step 1
Roast in a preheated oven at 200°C for about 25-30 minutes, until golden and tender.
Add cherry tomatoes & cheese
Cut cherry tomatoes in halves and scatter them over the potatoes. Sprinkle with grated cheese.
Bake - Step 2
Return to oven for another 5-7 minutes, just until the cheese melts and tomatoes soften slightly.
Serve
Garnish with fresh herbs and enjoy warm or at room temperature

recipes.t: Stuffed Peppers with Bulgur, Vegetables, and Cheese
i: 100 g hard cheese (e.g., Gouda, Mozzarella, or Suluguni)
Salt, pepper, oregano, basil to taste
p: Cook the bulgur
Rinse the bulgur and cook it until tender (usually 2 parts water to 1 part bulgur, cook for 10-12 minutes).
Prepare the vegetables
Chop the onion, grate the carrot, and sauté both in oil until soft.
Add chopped tomato and simmer for another 5 minutes. Season with salt, pepper, and spices.
Mix the filling
Combine the bulgur with the vegetables, add 2/3 of the grated cheese, and mix well. You can add some fresh herbs too.
Prepare the peppers
Cut the peppers in half and remove the seeds. Place them in a baking dish.
Stuff and bake
Fill the peppers with the filling. Sprinkle the remaining cheese on top.
Bake at 180°C for about 25-30 minutes until the cheese is golden brown.
Serving
Garnish with fresh herbs before serving. Delicious hot or slightly cooled.

i: Honey or erythritol - to taste (1-2 tsp)
Optional: vanilla extract, cinnamon, lemon zest
Berries (e.g. blueberries, raspberries) - a small handful
p: Mix cottage cheese, egg, yogurt, sweetener, and optional flavorings until smooth (use a fork or blender).
Pour the mixture into a greased baking dish or silicone mold.
Add berries on top, or gently mix them in.
Bake at 180°C for 25-30 minutes, until golden on top.
Let it cool slightly before serving - it will firm up as it cools.
This version is soft and fluffy - almost like a soufflé. You can also add 1 tsp of cocoa powder for a chocolate twist
Rinse the quinoa under cold water.
In a pot, combine quinoa with 200 ml of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for about 15 minutes, until the water is absorbed. Remove from heat and let it sit for 5 minutes.
Boil the eggs until hard-boiled (about 8-10 minutes). Cool, peel, and slice them.
Dice the tomatoes and avocado.
In a large bowl, mix the cooked quinoa, corn, tomatoes, and avocado.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss gently.
Add the sliced eggs on top or mix them in.
Garnish with fresh herbs if desired.
Grate the zucchini finely and let it sit for 10-15 minutes to drain excess liquid.
Add the egg, flour, herbs, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Heat a non-stick pan. For the first batch, grease the pan with coconut oil; afterward, you can cook without oil.
Spoon the batter onto the pan and fry the pancakes on both sides until golden brown.
for 1 serving (150-160g)

i: 1 tsp cream cheese or Greek yogurt (spread on the toast)
A pinch of white sesame seeds (for topping)
A cup of green tea or matcha
Plus 6-8 pieces of your favorite nuts (like almonds, walnuts, or cashews)
p: Toast the bread until golden and crispy.
Spread cream cheese or Greek yogurt on the toast.
Top with avocado slices and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Fry the egg to your liking.
Cut the cucumber and tomatoes, and add lettuce.
Arrange everything on a plate and serve with tea or matcha and a small handful of nuts 6-8

i: 1 medium sweet potato, peeled and cut into cubes (~220 g)
A handful of leafy greens (like rocket, spinach, or salad mix) (~40 g)
2 tsp olive oil (~9 g) plus extra for roasting
Optional: a sprinkle of dried basil or oregano
Optional add-ins: a few tbsp of chickpeas or toasted seeds (like pumpkin or sunflower) (~30 g)
p: Roast the sweet potato
Toss the cubed sweet potato with a little olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Roast in the oven at 200°C for about 25 minutes or until golden and tender.
Prepare the salad
While the sweet potato is roasting, slice the cucumber and tomatoes, and wash the greens.
Assemble the salad
In a large bowl, combine the roasted sweet potato, greens, tomatoes, and cucumber.
Add crumbled feta on top and drizzle with olive oil. Season with salt, pepper, and herbs if using.
(Optional): Add some chickpeas for protein or sprinkle with seeds for crunch.

i: 1 medium head of broccoli, cut into florets (~250 g)
Fresh herbs (parsley or dill) for garnish (optional)
p: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Place the broccoli florets and zucchini slices on a baking tray or in a roasting dish. Drizzle with 1 tbsp olive oil, sprinkle with salt, pepper, and half of the chopped garlic. Toss to coat evenly.
Roast the vegetables in the oven for 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, add the salmon fillets to the tray. Drizzle the remaining olive oil over the fish, season with salt, pepper, lemon zest, and the rest of the garlic.
Squeeze lemon juice over everything.
Roast for another 12-15 minutes, until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Remove from the oven and garnish with fresh herbs if desired.

i: 60 ml milk (optional, for a fluffier texture)
30g cheese (e.g. mozzarella or cheddar), shredded or cubed
A little oil or butter for cooking
p: Prepare the ingredients
Beat the eggs with milk, salt, and pepper.
Dice the tomato and wash the spinach.
Cook the omelette
Heat a small amount of oil or butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour in the egg mixture and cook for 1-2 minutes until it starts to set.
Add the filling
On one half of the omelette, place the cheese, tomato, and spinach.
Fold the omelette over to cover the filling.
Finish cooking
Let it cook for another 1-2 minutes until the cheese melts and the omelette is fully cooked.
Serve
Slide the omelette onto a plate and garnish with a spinach leaf if desired.
After the meal
Enjoy a cup of hot tea with a small handful of nuts (such as almonds, walnuts, or cashews) for a healthy and energizing finish to your breakfast.

recipes.t: Chia Pudding with Yogurt, Kiwi & Nuts
i: 150 ml water (filtered or boiled and cooled)
100 g unsweetened plant-based yogurt (e.g. coconut, soy, almond)
1-2 tbsp chopped nuts (e.g. walnuts, hazelnuts, almonds, cashews)
Optional: cacao nibs or grated dark chocolate for topping
p: Prepare chia pudding
Mix chia seeds with water. Stir well, wait 5 minutes, then stir again to avoid clumps. Refrigerate for at least 4-6 hours or overnight until it forms a gel-like consistency.
Prep the toppings
Chop the kiwi. Lightly toast the nuts in a dry pan (optional) and chop them.
Assemble the breakfast in layers
Layer of chia pudding
Layer of yogurt
Layer of kiwi
Repeat if desired
Top with chopped nuts and cacao nibs

recipes.t: Pasta with Pesto & Finely Chopped Chicken (2-Day Meal Prep)
i: 150 g whole wheat pasta (instead of regular pasta - for more fiber and fewer calories)
15 g nuts (pine nuts, walnuts, or cashews) - halve the amount
1 tbsp nutritional yeast or 15 g low-fat cheese (optional)
p: Make the pesto by blending basil, nuts, garlic, olive oil, salt, pepper, and nutritional yeast or cheese until smooth.
Cook whole wheat pasta in salted water until al dente. Drain, reserving 2-3 tbsp pasta water.
Finely dice the chicken breasts. Sauté in 1 tbsp olive oil with salt, pepper, and optional garlic until golden and fully cooked (about 8-10 minutes).
In a large bowl, combine pasta, pesto, a splash of pasta water, and chicken. Toss well until evenly coated.
Put the carrot, apple, and orange into a blender.
Add water.
Blend until smooth. Add more water if needed.
Pour into a glass and enjoy immediately!

i: 2 medium zucchinis (sliced into rounds or half-moons)
2 medium sweet potatoes (peeled and cut into cubes or slices)
p: Preheat oven to 200°C.
In a large bowl, toss the vegetables with olive oil, herbs, paprika, salt, pepper, and garlic (if using).
Spread the veggies out in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Roast for 25 minutes.
Remove the baking sheet, sprinkle the grated Parmesan evenly over the vegetables, then return to the oven for another 5-7 minutes until the cheese melts and browns slightly.
Divide into 2 portions and store in the fridge.

i: Salt and black pepper to taste
Fresh herbs (like chopped chives or green onion)
p: Toast the bread slices until golden and crispy.
In a bowl, mash the avocado with a fork. Add lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Spread the mashed avocado evenly over each toast.
Boil the eggs (around 7-8 minutes for a slightly soft yolk), peel, and slice them.
Place the egg slices on top of the avocado toast.
Sprinkle with fresh herbs, red pepper flakes, and more black pepper if desired.
Serve and enjoy while warm.
Afterward: 1 apple

recipes.t: Healthy Lunch with Chickpea Patties, Buckwheat & Fresh Salad
i: Cooked chickpeas - 200 g (or canned, rinsed and drained)
Oat flour or ground oats - 1-2 tbsp (approx. 20-30 g)
Salt, black pepper, turmeric, garlic - to taste
For a vegan version: replace the egg with 1 tbsp ground flaxseed + 3 tbsp water (let sit for 10 min).
p: Blend the chickpeas in a food processor until smooth (some chunks are fine).
Add grated carrot, chopped onion, egg, spices, and oat flour. Mix well.
Shape into 4 patties. Bake at 180°C for 20-25 minutes or pan-fry on a non-stick skillet without oil.
Buckwheat
Dry buckwheat - 80 g
Water - 160 ml
Salt - to taste
Preparation: Rinse, then simmer in water with a pinch of salt for ~15 minutes until soft.
Fresh Veggie Salad
Cabbage - 100 g
Carrot - 30 g
Cucumber - 70 g
Olive oil - 1 tsp per serving
Lemon juice or apple cider vinegar - 1 tsp
Salt - to taste
Preparation: Shred or grate all veggies, mix, and dress with oil and lemon juice/vinegar.

i: 1 small tomato or a few cherry tomatoes
A handful of lettuce, spinach, or arugula
A few thin slices of red onion (optional)
p: Prep the veggies
Slice the cucumber into half-moons or thin slices.
Dice or slice the tomato.
Slice olives into rings.
Crumble or cube the feta/bryndza.
Assemble the wrap
Lay the lavash flat on a clean surface.
Add a layer of greens.
Evenly distribute the cucumber, tomato, olives, and feta.
Drizzle with olive oil.
Sprinkle with oregano, pepper, and a little salt if needed (feta is already salty).
Wrap it up
Roll the lavash into a wrap or fold it like a burrito.
Optional: Toast it on a dry skillet for 1-2 minutes per side for a crispy finish.
Add a spoonful of Greek yogurt or yogurt-based sauce for extra creaminess.

i: 2 tbsp nuts (pine nuts, walnuts, or pecans)
p: Prepare the peaches
Slice them into wedges.
Optionally, lightly grill or sear them on a dry pan for 1-2 minutes per side until slightly caramelized.
Cut or crumble the feta cheese.
In a large bowl, combine arugula, warm peaches, feta, and nuts.
Make the dressing
Mix olive oil, honey, balsamic vinegar, salt, and pepper. Drizzle over the salad right before serving.

i: White wine vinegar (or apple cider vinegar) - 1 tsp
Ice cubes - optional, for instant chilling
p: Blanch the tomatoes in boiling water for 30 seconds, then peel off the skins.
Roughly chop all the vegetables (no need to be precise - everything will be blended).
Add chopped veggies to a blender with garlic, olive oil, vinegar, salt, pepper, and water.
Blend until smooth. For a silkier texture, strain through a fine mesh sieve (optional).
Chill in the refrigerator for 1-2 hours or add ice cubes if you want it cold right away.
Serve in bowls or glasses. Garnish with diced veggies, herbs, or a small drizzle of olive oil.
For added protein, serve with a boiled egg or whole-grain toast with hummus.

recipes.t: Salmon with Potatoes and Fresh Salad
i: Lamb's lettuce or baby spinach - ~100 g
Fresh or dried herbs (parsley, dill, basil) - optional
p: Potatoes
Peel and cut into medium chunks.
Boil in salted water until tender (about 15-20 minutes).
Drain, toss with 1 tsp olive oil and sprinkle with chopped herbs.
Salmon
Season fillets with salt, pepper, lemon juice, and herbs.
Sear in a non-stick pan for 2-3 minutes per side, or
Bake at 180°C for 12-15 minutes.
Salad
Rinse the greens thoroughly.
Dress with lemon juice and a few drops of olive oil.
(Optional: mix in a bit of mustard or plain yogurt for a creamy dressing.)

i: 1 tsp honey (5 g) - (or swap for peanut butter if preferred)
1 tsp peanut butter (5 g) - (optional, can replace honey or use half of each)
p: Place the cottage cheese into a bowl.
Add sliced strawberries on top.
Sprinkle with granola evenly.
Drizzle with honey or peanut butter (or a bit of both).
Add cinnamon or vanilla extract for extra flavor.

recipes.t: Rice Cakes with Avocado, Egg, Arugula & Veggies
i: Tea or coffee (unsweetened, with low-fat or plant-based milk) - ~20-30 kcal
p: Mash the avocado with a fork, mix in a bit of lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Spread the avocado mixture on the rice cakes.
Slice the hard-boiled eggs in half.
Arrange the eggs, tomato slices, and arugula on the plate.
Optionally, drizzle extra lemon juice over the veggies or eggs.
Serve with a cup of tea or coffee (no sugar).

i: 50-70 g canned tuna in water (about 1/2 can)
1 handful of lettuce leaves (e.g., iceberg, romaine, or mix)
p: Slice the egg and cucumber.
Tear the lettuce into bite-sized pieces.
Drain the tuna and corn.
Combine everything in a bowl and top with avocado slices if using.
Add a light drizzle of olive oil and lemon juice, or enjoy it without dressing - it's juicy and flavorful on its own.

recipes.t: Stuffed Zucchini with Chickpeas or Chicken
i: Cooked chickpeas or finely chopped cooked chicken - 100 g
Fresh tomatoes or cherry tomatoes - 1-2 medium
Tomato sauce or crushed tomatoes - 2-3 tbsp
Shredded cheese (mozzarella, gouda, or suluguni) - 40-50 g
Fresh herbs (parsley, dill, or basil) - 1-2 tbsp, chopped
p: Prep the zucchini
Cut the zucchini in half lengthwise and scoop out the center with a spoon.
Sprinkle with salt and brush with olive oil.
Pre-bake at 180°C for 10 minutes until slightly softened.
Make the filling
Sauté chopped onion (and garlic if using) in a little oil.
Add the chickpeas or finely chopped chicken and cook for a few minutes.
Stir in diced tomatoes and tomato sauce. Season with salt, pepper, and herbs.
Simmer for a few minutes until thickened.
Mix in a bit of fresh chopped herbs.
Assemble
Fill the pre-baked zucchini boats with the warm filling.
Sprinkle with shredded cheese on top.
Bake
Bake at 180°C for 15-20 minutes, until the cheese is melted and golden.
Serve
Top with remaining fresh herbs.
Optional: drizzle with yogurt, pesto, or balsamic glaze.

recipes.t: Bulgar with Vegetables, Chickpeas & Optional Tofu
i: Cooked or canned chickpeas - 1/2 can (approx. 150 g)
Salt, pepper, turmeric or paprika - to taste
Note: You can skip the tofu if you prefer - the dish will still be delicious and filling!
p: Prepare the tofu (if using)
Cut tofu into small cubes.
Marinate in soy sauce, paprika, and garlic powder for 10-15 minutes.
Fry in a pan until golden brown, or bake in the oven at 200°C for ~20 minutes.
Cook the bulgur with vegetables
Finely chop the onion, carrot, and bell pepper.
Sauté onion in olive oil until translucent. Add the carrot and bell pepper. Cook until slightly soft.
Add bulgur and stir for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in water or broth, add salt and spices. Cover and simmer on low heat for ~12-15 minutes, until the bulgur absorbs all liquid.
Stir in the chickpeas and cook for another 2-3 minutes to warm them through.
Serve
Spoon the bulgur mixture onto a plate. Top with crispy tofu (if using). Garnish with herbs if desired.

recipes.t: Green Omelet with Spinach, Corn & Cheese
i: 1 tbsp plant-based milk (optional - oat, almond, etc.)
A pinch of turmeric (optional, for color & health benefits)
A little oil for cooking (e.g., coconut or olive oil) or non-stick pan
Fresh spinach leaves - a small handful
Corn (boiled or canned, no sugar) - 2 tbsp
Light cheese (e.g., feta light, cottage cheese, or grated mozzarella) - 1-2 tbsp
Jamón (Spanish cured ham), thinly sliced - ~20-30 g
p: Make the green omelet base
Blend the eggs, spinach, milk, salt, and spices until smooth and vibrant green.
Cook the omelet
Pour the mixture into a heated non-stick pan. Cover with a lid and cook on low until the top is set.
Add the filling
On one half of the omelet, add spinach leaves, corn, cheese, and turkey (if using). Fold the omelet in half.
Serve and decorate
Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Serve with a small side of seaweed, veggie roll, or your favorite healthy toppings.

recipes.t: Rye Toast with Avocado, Egg & Figs
i: 2 slices of rye or whole grain bread
1 soft-boiled egg (boil for ~6 minutes after water starts boiling)
2 tbsp soft cheese (such as ricotta, cream cheese, or feta)
1 tsp seed mix (e.g. sesame, flax, chia, pumpkin seeds)
Optional: a few drops of olive oil or lemon juice
p: Toast the bread until golden and crisp.
Spread soft cheese evenly over both slices.
Layer sliced avocado on top.
Sprinkle with seed mix and add salt or pepper if desired.
Soft-boil the egg, peel, cut in half, and place on the plate.
Add halved figs on the side for a sweet touch.
Optionally drizzle avocado with olive oil or lemon juice.

i: 180 g cooked jasmine or basmati rice
100 g mozzarella (mini balls or soft chunks)
Soy sauce, garlic, paprika (for tofu marinade)
1 fruit of your choice - apple, banana, kiwi, pear, berries, etc.
p: Cook the rice according to package instructions. Optional: add a bit of tomato paste or spices for color and taste.
Prepare the tofu
Marinate tofu cubes in soy sauce, olive oil, garlic, and paprika for 10-15 minutes.
Then pan-fry until golden or bake at 200°C for 15-20 minutes.
Make the salad
Mix arugula, radishes, and cherry tomatoes.
Add mozzarella and drizzle with balsamic glaze.
Assemble the bowl
In each bowl, place a portion of rice, tofu, and salad.
Optionally, drizzle with lemon juice or olive oil.
Prepare the cabbage
Cut the cabbage into steaks, wash and dry.
Prepare the marinade
Mix olive oil, minced garlic, paprika, dried herbs, salt and pepper.
Add lemon juice for freshness.
Marinate the cabbage and chickpeas
Coat the cabbage steak with the marinade.
Mix the chickpeas with spices and 0.5 tbsp. of olive oil.
Bake
Place the cabbage and chickpeas on a baking sheet lined with parchment.
Bake in an oven preheated to 200°C for 20-25 minutes.
5 minutes before the steak is done, sprinkle the steak with cheese (if using).

i: Milk or water (or a mix of both) - 200 ml
Nuts (walnuts, almonds, cashews, etc.) - 10-15 g (1 tbsp)
p: Prepare the base
Combine oats with milk or water in a saucepan.
Add a pinch of salt and cinnamon.
Bring to a boil, then simmer on low heat for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the banana
Mash half of the banana and stir it into the oats while cooking - this will make the oatmeal naturally sweet and creamy.
Slice the other half into rounds for topping.
Finishing touches
Once the oats are cooked, remove from heat.
Transfer to a bowl. Top with banana slices, chopped nuts, and optionally honey or syrup, and chia or flax seeds.

i: Egg - 1 (you can use just the white for lower fat)
Oat or rice flour - 1.5-2 tbsp (or coconut flour for a gluten-free version)
Sweetener or honey - to taste (e.g. 1 tsp honey or 1/2 tsp erythritol)
Optional: vanilla, cinnamon, pinch of salt
Oil for frying (coconut, olive, or none on a non-stick pan) - 1/2 tsp or skip
p: Mix cottage cheese, egg, and sweetener until smooth (use a fork or blender).
Add flour and form small round pancakes.
Cook on a non-stick pan over medium heat for 2-3 minutes per side, until golden.
Serve with
Greek yogurt (1-2 tbsp)
Fresh berries (e.g. blueberries, strawberries)
1 tsp honey or maple syrup
A sprinkle of chopped nuts (for crunch)

recipes.t: Healthy Chicken Pasta in Creamy Tomato Sauce
i: Whole grain pasta (rigatoni, penne, or fusilli) - 150 g (dry weight)
Tomato puree or canned tomatoes - 200 ml
Greek yogurt (2-5%) or light cream (10%) - 2-3 tbsp
Salt, black pepper, paprika, garlic powder, Italian herbs - to taste
p: Boil the pasta in salted water until al dente. Drain and save 2-3 tbsp of the cooking water.
In a pan, sauté the chopped onion in olive oil for about 2 minutes until soft.
Add garlic and diced chicken, cook until fully cooked and golden (~5-6 minutes).
Pour in the tomato puree, add spices, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the Greek yogurt or cream and mix well into a creamy sauce.
Add the cooked pasta and a bit of the reserved pasta water. Stir and simmer together for 1-2 more minutes.
Serve topped with Parmesan and fresh herbs.

recipes.t: Green Smoothie with Kiwi, Berries & Spinach
p: Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Blend for 30-60 seconds until smooth.
Serve immediately. Enjoy cold!

recipes.t: Avocado, Feta, and Herb Salad with Lemon Dressing
i: A handful of fresh herbs (parsley, dill, basil - your choice)
A handful of walnuts or pine nuts (for crunch)
Salt and black pepper to taste
p: Peel and dice the avocado.
Wash the cucumber, peel if you like, and slice into half-moons or cubes.
Finely chop the herbs.
Toast the nuts lightly in a dry pan for extra flavor.
In a bowl, combine the avocado, cucumber, herbs, and nuts.
Add the feta, crumbled or cut into small cubes.
Drizzle with lemon juice and olive oil, then season with salt and pepper to taste.
Gently toss everything together, being careful not to mash the avocado.

recipes.t: Avocado Toast, Egg White Omelette & Fresh Salad
i: 1 slice of whole grain or rye bread
1 tsp olive oil or a drop of coconut oil
A pinch of salt and pepper
A handful of arugula or mixed greens
A few drops of lemon juice
p: Avocado Toast
Toast the bread until golden.
Mash the avocado with a fork, season with salt and pepper.
Spread it over the toast and sprinkle with seeds.
Egg White Omelette
Separate the egg whites from the yolks.
Lightly whisk the egg whites.
Heat the oil in a pan and pour in the egg whites.
Cook on low heat for about 2-3 minutes until set.
Fresh Salad
Slice the tomatoes and mix with arugula.
Add pumpkin seeds.
Drizzle with a bit of olive oil and lemon juice.

i: 30-40 g cheese (feta, bryndza, or hard cheese - your choice)
A few drops of lemon juice (optional)
p: Broccoli - steam or boil for 3-4 minutes until tender but still bright green.
Asparagus - trim the ends and sauté in olive oil for 2-3 minutes until slightly golden.
Egg - fry to your liking (sunny side up or medium).
Cucumber & Avocado - slice thinly.
Cheese - crumble if using feta or bryndza, or cut into cubes if using hard cheese.
Assembly - arrange everything nicely on a plate. Season with salt and pepper, drizzle with lemon juice and olive oil if desired.

i: Tuna in water (canned) - 2 cans of 120 g each (≈200 g drained tuna)
p: Cook the buckwheat (120 g) in 240 ml of water until tender (~15-20 minutes).
Chop tomatoes, bell pepper, and cucumber. Mix with olive oil, salt, pepper, and herbs.
Drain the tuna from the liquid.
Serve one portion with about 150 g cooked buckwheat, 100 g tuna, and 200-250 g vegetable salad.

recipes.t: Roasted Potatoes with Zucchini, Feta & Vegetables
i: Dried herbs (oregano or Provençal mix) - 1/2 tsp
Fresh herbs (parsley, dill, or basil) - for serving
p: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Cut the potatoes into wedges (with or without skin), slice the zucchini into rounds, and slice the pepper and onion into strips or half-rings.
In a bowl, toss all the vegetables with olive oil, salt, pepper, herbs, and minced garlic (if using).
Spread everything on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Bake for 25-30 minutes, until the vegetables are tender and lightly golden.
Add the feta cheese on top during the last 5 minutes of baking so it softens slightly.
Serve warm, sprinkled with fresh herbs.

recipes.t: Cottage Cheese with Banana, Peach & Almonds
i: 100-150 g of cottage cheese (low-fat or medium-fat)
1 tsp of honey or Jerusalem artichoke syrup (optional)
p: Place the cottage cheese in a bowl.
Add the sliced banana and peach on top.
Sprinkle with almonds.
Drizzle with honey or syrup if you like it a bit sweeter.
Optional: Add some chia seeds or flax seeds for extra nutrients.

recipes.t: Healthy Breakfast with Toast, Veggies, and Eggs
i: 1 tbsp soft cheese (e.g., cream cheese or ricotta)
p: Boil the eggs
Place the eggs in boiling water and cook for about 6-7 minutes for soft-boiled. Cool them under cold water and peel.
Avocado toast
Mash the avocado in a bowl.
Add finely chopped tomatoes, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Spread the mixture on one slice of toasted bread.
Veggie toast
Spread soft cheese on the second slice of bread.
Top with fresh arugula and diced cucumber.
Serve
Slice the boiled eggs in half and season with salt and pepper.
Arrange everything on a plate and serve warm.
green tea

i: 85 g dry quinoa (yields about 260 g cooked)
80 g cooked or canned chickpeas (rinsed and drained)
100 g of fresh berries (e.g., blueberries, strawberries, raspberries) - for dessert or on the side
p: Cook the quinoa
Rinse the quinoa under cold water.
Add 85 g quinoa and 240 ml water to a pot, bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Let sit for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Prepare the veggies
Dice the cucumber into chunks.
Halve the cherry tomatoes.
Cut the avocado into cubes and drizzle with lemon juice to prevent browning.
Assemble the bowl
Divide the cooked quinoa between two bowls.
Top with chickpeas, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, and avocado.
Drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Finish with berries
Serve 100 g of fresh berries per person as a refreshing finish or enjoy them on the side.

recipes.t: Baked Red Salmon with a Crispy Green Salad
i: 2 pieces of red salmon fillet (150-180 g each)
Salt and black pepper, to taste
A handful of arugula or mixed salad greens
50 g canned or cooked green peas
1 tsp apple cider vinegar or lemon juice
p: Bake the salmon
Preheat the oven to 180°C with top and bottom heat or fan mode.
Line a baking dish with parchment paper or lightly grease it.
Place the salmon fillets skin-side down.
Brush each piece with olive oil and drizzle with lemon juice.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper, oregano, and add a bit of garlic on top.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until the fish is tender and flakes easily with a fork.
Prepare the salad
In a bowl, combine arugula, sliced cucumber, radishes, and green peas.
In a separate small bowl, whisk together olive oil, vinegar or lemon juice, salt, pepper, and (if using) Dijon mustard.
Dress the salad and toss just before serving.
To serve
Place a piece of baked salmon on each plate.
Add a portion of the salad alongside.
Garnish with a lemon wedge and fresh herbs if desired.

i: Fresh spinach leaves - a small handful
Fresh herbs (dill, parsley, or your choice) - to taste
Feta cheese or hummus (optional, as a spread) - 1 tbsp
p: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Heat a non-stick pan with a little oil and cook the eggs like a flat omelette over low heat, without flipping.
Once nearly cooked, spread feta or hummus on top (optional).
Add spinach, sliced avocado, and chopped herbs.
Fold the omelette in half.
Sprinkle sesame seeds over the top before serving.

recipes.t: Baked Sweet Potato with Crispy Chickpeas & Broccoli
i: Paprika, turmeric, or your favorite spices - to taste
Arugula or other greens - a handful (for serving)
p: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Wash the sweet potatoes, pierce them with a fork, and bake for 40-50 minutes until soft.
Meanwhile, pat the chickpeas dry, mix with 1 tbsp olive oil, spices, and salt. Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes until crispy (can be done alongside the sweet potatoes).
Steam or lightly boil the broccoli for 5-7 minutes until bright green and slightly crunchy.
Once the sweet potatoes are ready, cut them open lengthwise and gently mash the inside.
Fill with crispy chickpeas, broccoli, and top with fresh greens.
Drizzle with olive oil before serving.

recipes.t: Ratatouille with Bell Pepper and Cheese
i: Hard cheese (e.g., Parmesan, mozzarella, or Gouda) - 40-50 g
Herbes de Provence or oregano - 1/2 tsp
Tomato sauce or crushed tomatoes - 150 ml
p: Slice the vegetables thinly into rounds: zucchini, yellow squash, and tomato. Slice the bell pepper into thin rings or strips.
Sauce: sauté onion and garlic in olive oil, add tomato sauce, season, and simmer for 5-7 minutes. Pour into a baking dish.
Arrange the vegetables in a circle on top of the sauce. Drizzle with olive oil and add spices.
Cheese: grate the cheese and sprinkle it on top of the vegetables, or add it 10 minutes before the dish is done (for a golden crust).
Baking: bake at 180°C for 30-35 minutes. If cheese is on top, bake uncovered or cover with foil and remove it near the end.
In a small bowl or jar, mix 150 g of yogurt with 10 g of chia seeds.
Add 5 g of honey or syrup (optional) and stir well.
Let it sit for 15-20 minutes, or refrigerate overnight to allow the chia seeds to expand and soften.
Before serving, top with 100 g of chopped fresh fruit.
Optionally, sprinkle 10 g of nuts or granola on top for added crunch.

i: 5-6 cherry tomatoes or 1 small regular tomato
1-2 tbsp chopped green onion or parsley (optional)
2 slices of whole grain bread (with seeds, if desired)
Tea (green, black, or herbal - your choice)
p: Peel and mash the avocado in a bowl using a fork.
Dice the boiled eggs and add them to the avocado.
Chop the tomatoes and herbs, then mix them in.
Add lemon juice, salt, and pepper to taste.
Toast the bread slices until golden and crispy.
Spread the mixture evenly over the toasted bread.
Serve with a cup of hot black coffee or tea.

recipes.t: Rice Bowl with Chicken, Avocado & Mozzarella
p: Cook the rice
Rinse and cook rice using a 1:2 ratio (rice:water) until done. Set aside to cool slightly.
Prepare the chicken
Cut chicken breast into cubes. Heat olive oil in a pan and fry the chicken until golden and fully cooked. Season with salt, pepper, and your favorite herbs or spices.
Prepare the vegetables and cheese
Slice the cucumber, cherry tomatoes, avocado, and mozzarella.
Assemble the bowl
Place the rice in the center of each plate. Arrange chicken, corn, cheese, cucumber, tomatoes, and avocado around the rice. Sprinkle with herbs or a drizzle of olive oil if desired.

i: Canned tuna in its own juice - 300 g
Chinese cabbage or mixed greens - 200 g
p: Prepare the ingredients
Finely shred the cabbage or greens. Break the tuna into chunks using a fork. Cut the tomatoes into quarters.
Mix the salad
In a large salad bowl, combine the cabbage (or greens), tuna, tomatoes, and herbs. Dress with lemon juice and olive oil. Add your favorite spices and mix well.
Divide into two portions
Store one portion in the refrigerator for the next evening. Best served chilled or at room temperature.

i: 1-2 tbsp honey or any natural sweetener
A handful of grapes or seasonal fruit
Hot black tea or green tea
Optional: lemon slice, mint, or a teaspoon of honey
p: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
In a bowl, mix cottage cheese, eggs, oat flour, Greek yogurt, honey, vanilla, and salt until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a small baking dish lined with parchment or lightly greased.
Evenly add berries on top (press them lightly into the mixture).
Bake for 30-35 minutes until golden and set.
Let it cool slightly, then cut into 2 equal portions - one for each day.
Before serving, add fresh fruits and a sprinkle of powdered erythritol if desired.
Serve with a cup of hot tea.

recipes.t: Quinoa with Chicken and Fresh Spinach Salad
i: Salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder (to taste)
A splash of lemon juice or balsamic vinegar (optional)
A handful of fresh spinach leaves
1-2 tsp pumpkin seeds or sesame seeds
Salt, pepper, lemon juice or balsamic vinegar - to taste
p: Quinoa with Chicken
Rinse the quinoa thoroughly. Cook it in a 1:2 ratio with water (~15 minutes) until soft and fluffy.
Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt, pepper, paprika, and garlic powder. Sauté or bake with a little olive oil until golden and cooked through.
Mix the cooked quinoa with the chicken. Optionally, drizzle with a little lemon juice or low-sodium soy sauce.
Salad
Wash and slice the vegetables.
Mix with fresh spinach and seeds.
Dress with olive oil, salt, pepper, and a splash of lemon juice or balsamic vinegar.
Serving
Serve half of the quinoa-chicken mix and half of the salad on a plate.
Store the remaining portion in the fridge for the next day.

recipes.t: Roasted Sweet Potato, Green Beans & Cheese
i: 1 medium sweet potato (~300 g), peeled and diced
100-120 g feta cheese or mozzarella (light version if preferred)
Salt, pepper, paprika, oregano or rosemary - to taste
p: Roasted Sweet Potato
Preheat oven to 200°C.
Dice the sweet potato, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt, paprika, and a bit of oregano or rosemary.
Place on a baking sheet and roast for about 25 minutes until tender and slightly crispy.
Green Beans
If using frozen green beans, blanch or lightly boil for 5 minutes in salted water.
Alternatively, sauté in a non-stick pan with a small amount of olive oil.
Add minced garlic at the end for extra flavor.
Cheese
Cut feta into cubes or crumble over the plate.
If using mozzarella, add it to the roasted sweet potato during the last 5 minutes of baking to slightly melt.
Serving (for 2 people)
Plate half of the roasted sweet potato and green beans on each plate.
Top with cheese of choice.
Optionally sprinkle with some pumpkin or flax seeds for texture.

i: a little olive oil or butter for frying
p: Beat the eggs with salt and pepper.
Heat a non-stick pan with a small amount of oil.
Pour in the eggs and cook gently over low heat until just set.
Sprinkle with sesame or za'atar.
Fold the omelet in half and cook for another 30 seconds, then remove from heat.
Toast with Cheese and Tomatoes
1 slice of rye or whole grain bread
2 tbsp cottage cheese or ricotta
1-2 ripe tomatoes, sliced
pinch of sea salt and black pepper
optional: a drizzle of olive oil
Toast the bread until crispy.
Spread the cheese generously over the toast.
Top with tomato slices.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Add a touch of olive oil if desired.
Fresh Herb Salad
arugula, spinach, mint, and dill (or any mix you like)
lemon juice
olive oil
pinch of salt
Rinse and lightly chop the herbs if needed.
Toss with lemon juice, olive oil, and a bit of salt.
Serve fresh alongside the omelet and toast.

i: Soft cheese or tofu - 150 g (e.g. cottage cheese, feta, or plain tofu)
or vegan scrambled tofu with broccoli bits
p: Cook the buckwheat
Rinse 170 g of buckwheat and cook in 480 ml of water with a pinch of salt. Simmer for 15-20 minutes until tender. Let cool slightly.
Steam the broccoli
Cut broccoli into florets and steam for 5-6 minutes until just tender and bright green.
Prepare fresh veggies
Chop lettuce, bell pepper, and cherry tomatoes. Keep them crisp.
Prepare creamy topping (instead of eggs)
Option 1: Lightly mash chickpeas with a fork, mix with olive oil, turmeric, and a dash of garlic powder.
Option 2: Crumble tofu and sauté with a bit of oil, turmeric, black pepper, and finely chopped steamed broccoli for a "scrambled" effect.
Assemble each bowl
Base: 170 g of cooked buckwheat
Add: broccoli, sliced avocado, cheese/tofu, fresh salad mix
Add the chickpea mash or tofu scramble in place of the egg
Season with olive oil, lemon juice, salt & pepper

recipes.t: Baked Zucchini with Feta, Tomatoes, and Parmesan
i: Fresh herbs (basil or oregano) for garnish
p: Preheat oven to 180°C.
In a baking dish, arrange the zucchini slices in a single layer.
Scatter the cherry tomatoes over the zucchini.
Sprinkle minced garlic, crumbled feta, and grated Parmesan evenly on top.
Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and pepper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until zucchini is tender and cheese is golden.
Garnish with fresh herbs before serving. video omitted

recipes.t: Nutritious Breakfast: Granola + Chia + Yogurt + Fruit
i: or some chopped apple, kiwi, or peach (50-70 g)
Honey or maple syrup (optional) - 5 g (1 tsp)
Crushed nuts or seeds (optional) - 5-7 g (e.g. walnuts or almonds)

recipes.t: Healthy Oatmeal with Fruits and Nuts
i: Milk or water - 200 ml (can use plant-based: almond, soy, oat milk)
Berries (raspberries, blueberries, strawberries) - a handful (fresh or frozen)
Flax seeds or chia seeds - 1 tsp
Honey or Jerusalem artichoke syrup - to taste (optional, about 1 tsp)
p: In a small pot, bring the milk or water to a boil.
Add the oats, reduce the heat, and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally until creamy.
Chop the banana and apple (or pear) into small pieces.
Once the oatmeal is ready, pour it into a bowl.
Top with fruits, berries, nuts, seeds, and a sprinkle of cinnamon.
Add a bit of honey or syrup if you want a sweeter taste.
Tips
For a quicker morning routine, prepare as overnight oats by soaking them in milk overnight.
You can replace fresh fruit with dried fruit (like dates or apricots).
For extra protein, add a spoonful of Greek yogurt or protein powder.

i: Vegetable or chicken broth (or water) - 400-450 ml
A small amount of hard cheese (like Parmesan) - optional for clean eating, can be skipped
p: Dice the chicken and chop all vegetables.
In a deep pan, heat the olive oil and sauté the chopped onion and garlic until soft.
Add the chicken and cook for about 5-6 minutes until golden.
Add the carrot, bell pepper, and zucchini (or broccoli), and sauté for another 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the rice and mix well to coat it with the flavors.
Gradually add hot broth (about 100-150 ml at a time), stirring constantly. Let the rice absorb the liquid before adding more.
Cook for 20-25 minutes until the rice is soft and creamy.
Season with salt, pepper, and spices. Add cheese at the end if using.
Serve warm, topped with chopped fresh herbs.

recipes.t: Green Berry Smoothie with Spinach, Banana & Berries
i: Mixed berries (blueberries, raspberries, strawberries, etc.) - 70 g (fresh or frozen)
Chia seeds or ground flaxseeds - 1 tsp
Honey or Jerusalem artichoke syrup - 1 tsp (optional)
Fresh lemon or lime juice - 1/2 tsp (optional, for brightness)
Ice cubes - a few (optional, for a chilled smoothie)
p: In a blender, combine the liquid (milk or water), banana, spinach, and berries.
Add the seeds, sweetener (if using), and a splash of lemon/lime juice.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Add ice cubes and blend briefly again if you prefer it cold.
Pour into a glass and top with extra berries or seeds if desired.

i: Salad greens (arugula, spinach, or mixed leaves) - 2 handfuls
Cheese (feta, goat cheese, or bryndza) - 50-70 g
Balsamic vinegar or lemon juice - 1 tsp
p: Slice the pear thinly or dice it. You can lightly sear it in a dry pan for 1-2 minutes or leave it fresh.
Toast the nuts in a dry skillet for a few minutes to enhance their aroma.
In a large bowl, add the salad greens.
Add the pear, crumbled cheese, and nuts.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, honey, vinegar or lemon juice, a pinch of salt, and pepper.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and gently toss to combine.
Swap feta for blue cheese (like gorgonzola) for a more intense flavor

i: Salt and black pepper - to taste
A small handful of nuts (e.g. almonds, walnuts, or cashews - about 10-15 g)
1 cup of tea (green, black, or herbal - your choice)
p: Prepare the zucchini
Use a spiralizer (or a julienne peeler or knife) to cut the zucchini into long thin strips (zoodles).
Sprinkle a little salt over them and let sit for 5-10 minutes.
Squeeze out excess moisture using paper towels or a clean cloth.
Make the nests
Heat 1 tsp of olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Divide the zucchini into two portions and shape each into a small nest, leaving a space in the center.
Carefully crack one egg into the center of each nest.
Season with salt, pepper, and chili flakes if desired.
Cover the pan with a lid and cook for 4-6 minutes, until the egg whites are set and the yolks are still runny (or longer if you prefer firmer yolks).
Slice the avocado
Cut the avocado in half, remove the pit, and slice thinly.
Arrange neatly on the plate next to the nests.
Add nuts
Serve a small handful of raw or lightly toasted nuts on the side.
Optional: sprinkle some crushed nuts on top of the avocado.
Prepare the tea
Brew your favorite tea.
Drink plain, or add a slice of lemon or a touch of honey if you like.

recipes.t: Scrambled Eggs with Avocado, Ricotta, Toast & Crispy Bacon
i: 1-2 slices of whole grain or seed bread
1 tbsp crispy crumbled bacon or plant-based alternative
1 tsp olive oil or a small piece of butter for cooking
p: Toast the bread.
Toast the bread in a pan or toaster until golden and crisp.
Make the scrambled eggs.
Lightly whisk the eggs in a small bowl.
Heat the oil or butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour in the eggs and gently stir continuously until soft and creamy.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Prepare the avocado.
Slice the avocado thinly or fan it out as shown in the photo.
Add a pinch of salt if you like.
Assemble the plate.
Place the scrambled eggs, avocado, toast, and a dollop of ricotta on a plate.
Sprinkle the crispy bacon over the eggs.
Serve and enjoy!
Optional: add a squeeze of lemon on the avocado or garnish with fresh herbs.

recipes.t: Pasta Salad with Pesto, Spinach & Cheese
p: Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente. Drain and let it cool completely.
Cut feta into small cubes, halve the cherry tomatoes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooled pasta, tomatoes, spinach, mozzarella, and feta.
Add pesto (and olive oil, if using), mix well. Season with salt and pepper.
Done! Store in the fridge in an airtight container. Eat cold or at room temperature.

recipes.t: Salmon with Baked Potatoes & Green Beans
i: Baked potatoes with herbs - 2 medium (about 300 g)
Lemon juice, dried herbs, salt, pepper, a bit of garlic
p: Marinate the salmon in yogurt and spices, then bake for 15 min at 180°C.
Cut potatoes into wedges, season with herbs and olive oil. Bake for ~25 min.
Boil or steam the green beans or asparagus for 5-7 minutes.
Serve with arugula, celery, fruit, and garnish with parsley and lemon.

recipes.t: Avocado Toast with Egg, Tomato & Jamón
i: 2 slices of whole-grain or rustic bread
3-4 slices of jamón (Spanish cured ham, about 30-40 g)
Salt and black pepper to taste
A few drops of lemon juice (optional)
p: Toast the bread until golden and crispy.
Mash the avocado with a fork in a small bowl. Add a pinch of salt, pepper, and a little lemon juice if you like.
Spread the avocado evenly over the toasted bread.
Slice the eggs into wedges and arrange them on top of the avocado.
Cut the tomatoes into small pieces and place them between the egg slices.
Tear the jamón into smaller pieces with your hands and add it on top or between the egg and tomato.
Season with extra pepper (and a little salt if needed). Drizzle with a touch of olive oil if desired.

i: Optional drink: plant-based milk with cinnamon (like in the photo)
p: Quinoa
Rinse the quinoa under running water.
Add 100 g quinoa to 200 ml of salted water.
Simmer, covered, for about 15 minutes until tender. Let it rest for 5 more minutes off the heat.
Eggs
Boil the eggs until soft-boiled (about 6-7 minutes after water starts boiling).
Cool under cold water and peel.
Broccoli
Lightly steam or blanch the broccoli for 3-5 minutes so it stays bright green and a bit crisp.
Avocado
Slice thinly, drizzle with lemon juice, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Cherry tomatoes
Slice in half or leave whole.
Assembly
Place quinoa in the center of each bowl.
Arrange avocado, cherry tomatoes, eggs, and broccoli around it.
Drizzle with a bit of olive oil and season with salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.t: Green Smoothie with Banana, Spinach & Seeds
i: 200 ml plant-based milk (e.g. oat, almond, or coconut)
1 tsp chia seeds or ground flax seeds
(Optional) 1-2 dates or 1 tsp honey for sweetness
(Optional) a few ice cubes for a refreshing touch
p: Rinse the spinach, peel the banana, and remove date pits if using.
Place all ingredients into a blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy (about 30 seconds).
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.
You can sprinkle some extra seeds on top or garnish with a mint leaf.

i: Lasagna sheets - 6 (no-boil or regular, pre-cooked if needed)
Canned tomatoes or fresh chopped tomatoes - 250 g
p: Make the veggie filling
Finely chop the onion, pepper, zucchini, and garlic.
Sauté in olive oil for 5-7 minutes.
Add tomato paste and chopped tomatoes. Season with salt, pepper, and oregano.
Simmer for 10-15 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Assemble the lasagna
Spread a spoonful of sauce on the bottom of a small baking dish.
Add a layer of lasagna sheets, then sauce, then a bit of cheese.
Repeat layers (about 2-3 total), ending with sauce and cheese on top.
Bake
Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 25-30 minutes.
Cover with foil for the first 15 minutes, then uncover to brown the top.
Serve
Let rest for 5-10 minutes before slicing.
Garnish with fresh basil if desired.

recipes.t: Avocado, Egg & Whole Grain Toast Breakfast
i: 2 boiled eggs (hard-boiled or soft - your choice)
2-3 cherry tomatoes (halved) or slices of fresh tomato
A pinch of salt and pepper
Optional extras: olive oil, lemon juice, sesame or flax seeds
p: Boil the eggs - 6-7 min for soft-boiled, 9 min for hard-boiled.
Toast the bread until golden and crispy.
Spread cream cheese over the toast.
Add sliced tomatoes on top. Lightly season with salt.
Slice or mash the avocado and place it on the side or on the toast.
Add the eggs, whole or halved.
Sprinkle with chopped green onion, black pepper, and optional toppings like a drizzle of olive oil or lemon juice.

i: Fresh tomatoes or canned tomatoes - 2 medium
Olive oil or vegetable oil - 1 tbsp
Fresh herbs (parsley or cilantro) - for garnish
p: Prep the vegetables
Finely chop the onion and pepper. Grate or dice the tomatoes. Mince the garlic.
Sauté
Heat the oil in a skillet.
Sauté the onion until soft, add the bell pepper, and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add garlic, paprika, cumin (optional), salt, and pepper.
Make the tomato sauce
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 5-7 minutes until the mixture thickens slightly.
Add the eggs
Make small wells in the sauce and crack the eggs into them.
Cover and cook for 4-5 minutes, or until the egg whites are set and yolks remain soft (or to your preference).
Serve
Sprinkle with fresh herbs and serve with bread or toast.

recipes.t: Chicken with Buckwheat and Tomato-Mozzarella Salad
i: 1 tbsp olive oil or cooking oil
Salt and black pepper, to taste
p: Cook the buckwheat
Rinse the buckwheat under cold water.
In a saucepan, bring the water to a boil. Add a pinch of salt.
Add the buckwheat, reduce heat to low, cover with a lid.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the water is fully absorbed.
Remove from heat and let sit covered for another 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork before serving.
Prepare the chicken
Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized cubes.
Season with paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Cook the chicken for 6-8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden and fully cooked through.
Make the salad
Dice the tomatoes and halve or leave whole the mozzarella balls.
Combine them in a bowl.
Add salt, pepper, oregano or basil, and olive oil (if using).
Toss gently and set aside.
Serving
Divide the cooked buckwheat evenly between two plates.
Add half of the chicken to each plate.
Serve with a generous portion of the tomato and mozzarella salad.

recipes.t: Baked Salmon with Roasted Tomatoes and Boiled Potatoes
i: Salt and black pepper - to taste
1/2 small onion, finely chopped + 1 tsp vegetable oil or butter
p: Boil the potatoes
Peel and rinse the potatoes.
Place them in a pot with salted water and bring to a boil.
Cook for 15-20 minutes until soft when pierced with a knife.
Drain and choose one of the following finishing options
With dill: Sprinkle with chopped fresh dill and optionally a bit of butter.
With onion: In a small pan, sauté chopped onion in 1 tsp oil or butter until golden. Mix with the warm potatoes.
Bake the salmon and tomatoes
Preheat the oven to 190°C.
Place the salmon fillets on a baking tray lined with parchment paper or foil.
Add whole or halved cherry tomatoes around the fish.
Drizzle everything with olive oil. Season with salt, pepper, and herbs.
Add minced garlic over tomatoes if using.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until the salmon is flaky and fully cooked.
Serve with lemon wedges if desired.
Serving
Each evening, serve
1 salmon fillet
Half the roasted tomatoes
Half the potatoes (with dill or onion)

recipes.t: Healthy Breakfast with Veggie Omelet, Cheese, and Veggies
p: Omelet
Heat a non-stick pan with olive oil over medium heat.
Lightly beat the eggs with salt and pepper.
Sauté the spinach and cherry tomatoes for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in the eggs, cover with a lid, and cook for 4-5 minutes until the omelet is set.
Serve
Arrange the omelet on a plate with sliced cucumber, cheese cubes, and one slice of whole grain bread.

i: Salt, pepper, dried basil or garlic to taste
120 g dry whole wheat penne pasta (or regular if preferred)
1-2 tbsp grated Parmesan or any hard cheese
p: Chicken
Season the chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and herbs.
Heat a non-stick pan with olive oil and cook the chicken for about 5-6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Let it rest for a couple of minutes, then slice into strips.
Pasta
Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente, then drain.
Pesto Sauce
Blend all pesto ingredients until smooth.
Add water if needed to make the sauce lighter and creamier.
Assemble
Mix the cooked pasta with the pesto sauce.
Top with sliced grilled chicken.
Garnish with a little extra grated cheese if desired.

recipes.t: Healthy Veggie Power Bowl (Dinner for 2 servings )
i: 160 g cooked or roasted chickpeas (drained and rinsed if canned)
60 g fresh spinach or mixed greens
Salt and black pepper to taste
Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped (optional for garnish)
Juice of 1/2 lemon (or use apple cider vinegar as a dressing)
p: Prepare Chickpeas (optional for extra flavor)
Toss cooked chickpeas in olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Roast in the oven at 200°C for ~15-20 minutes until crispy (optional step, can use them as-is).
Assemble the bowls
Divide spinach/mixed greens between two bowls.
Top each with half the avocado, one chopped egg, half the chickpeas, and half the tomatoes.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.
Season with salt, pepper, and fresh herbs to taste.

recipes.t: Breakfast Bowl with Beetroot, Arugula & Egg
i: Cooked or roasted beetroot - 1 piece (or 1/2 if large)
Boiled egg - 1 (soft- or medium-boiled, or poached)
Cheese - shaved Parmesan (or crumbled feta/goat cheese for a softer option)
Nuts or seeds - pumpkin, walnut, pine nuts (1 tbsp)
Balsamic vinegar or glaze - a few drops
Salt and black pepper - to taste
(optional) Avocado slices or a spoon of hummus - for extra creaminess and satiety
p: Slice or cube the beetroot.
Cook the egg to your liking (soft-boiled or poached works best).
In a bowl, layer the arugula, beetroot, and halved egg. Sprinkle with cheese and nuts/seeds.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic, and season with salt and pepper.
(Optional) Add a spoonful of hummus or avocado on the side.
Variations
Swap egg for soft goat cheese or roasted pumpkin purée.
Add crunch with crispy chickpeas or whole grain croutons.
Sprinkle with za'atar, sumac, or sesame seeds for extra flavor.

recipes.t: Zucchini Fritters with Cream Cheese and Cured Salmon
i: Fresh dill or green onion - to taste
A little olive oil for frying (optional if using a non-stick pan)
1-2 tbsp cream cheese or Greek yogurt
40-50 g lightly salted salmon or trout
( If you don't like fish - you can skip it and just serve with cream cheese or add a boiled egg or avocado instead - still delicious!)
p: Grate the zucchini finely, sprinkle with a little salt, and let sit for 5 minutes. Then squeeze out the excess liquid.
Add the egg, oat flour, chopped herbs, salt, and pepper. Mix until combined.
Heat a non-stick pan and cook the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden brown.
Serve with cream cheese (or Greek yogurt) and salmon (or one of the alternatives).
Optionally, sprinkle with black pepper or dried herbs.

i: 1-2 tsp lemon juice or apple cider vinegar
400 g white cabbage (about 1/2 a medium head)
Salt, black pepper, bay leaf, favorite herbs (e.g. paprika, garlic powder)
p: Bulgur
Bring water to a boil, add bulgur and a pinch of salt. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for about 10-12 minutes until tender. Let it rest covered for a few minutes.
Cucumber salad
Slice the cucumbers, season with salt and pepper, drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice (or vinegar), then toss gently.
Braised cabbage
Shred the cabbage and grate the carrots. Finely chop the onion if using.
In a large pan, heat olive oil. Sauté onion (if using), then add carrots and cabbage.
Season with salt, pepper, herbs, and tomato paste or juice.
Add a splash of water, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes on low heat, stirring occasionally, until soft.
Serve
Plate the bulgur, add a generous portion of braised cabbage and a side of cucumber salad.

i: Canned tuna in its own juice - 1 can (120-150 g drained)
Cherry tomatoes or regular tomatoes - 150-200 g
Lemon juice or balsamic vinegar - 1 tsp
Salt and black pepper - to taste
p: Rinse and dry the arugula.
Cut tomatoes into halves or chunks.
Cut the cheese into cubes (feta), tear it (mozzarella), or grate it (parmesan).
Drain the tuna and gently flake it with a fork.
In a large bowl, combine arugula, tomatoes, cheese, tuna, and olives.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice or balsamic vinegar. Add salt, pepper, and herbs. Toss gently.

recipes.t: Chia Pudding Bowl with Granola and Banana
i: A few freeze-dried raspberries or other dried berries
p: Make the chia pudding
Mix the chia seeds with milk and sweetener if using.
Stir well and let sit in the fridge for 4-6 hours or overnight.
Stir again after 10 minutes to prevent clumping.
Assemble the bowl
Spoon the chia pudding into a bowl.
Add granola on one side.
Place the banana slices in the center.
Sprinkle with almond flakes and freeze-dried raspberries.

i: Tomato - 1 medium (or a few cherry tomatoes)
Fresh herbs (optional) - parsley, arugula, or spinach
p: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add a pinch of salt and pepper, and beat well.
(No milk - just eggs.)
Chop the tomato into small cubes or slices.
Tear the prosciutto into bite-sized pieces.
Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped tomato and sauté for 1-2 minutes until some liquid evaporates.
Add the prosciutto and cook for another 30-60 seconds.
Pour in the beaten eggs and let cook without stirring. Cover with a lid if you want the top to cook evenly.
Once set, fold the omelet or leave it open-style.
Sprinkle with fresh

i: Salt, pepper, your favorite spices - to taste
p: Cook the rice in salted water until done (you can do this ahead of time). For a healthier option, use brown or parboiled rice.
Cut the vegetables
Carrot - into thin strips or rounds
Broccoli - into small florets
Bell pepper - into thin slices
Onion - into half-rings
Heat 2 tsp of oil in a pan. Sauté the vegetables for about 5-7 minutes over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
You can add a splash of water and cover with a lid to steam slightly.
Add the cooked rice, season with salt, pepper, spices, and soy sauce if using. Mix everything well.
Heat together for another 2-3 minutes - and it's ready!

recipes.t: Farfalle Pasta with Arugula, Cherry Tomatoes, Mozzarella, and Grilled Chicken Breast
i: Farfalle pasta (whole grain or durum wheat) - 120-140 g (dry)
Mozzarella (light, mini balls or regular) - 80-100 g
Salt, black pepper, oregano, basil - to taste
(Optional: a few drops of balsamic vinegar)
p: Boil the pasta until al dente. Drain and let cool slightly.
Cut the cooked or grilled chicken into small bite-sized pieces.
Halve the cherry tomatoes. Slice or cube the mozzarella if needed.
In a large bowl, combine the pasta, arugula, tomatoes, chicken, and mozzarella.
Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt, pepper, and herbs.
Add a splash of balsamic vinegar if desired.
Mix gently and serve warm or as a cold salad.

i: Avocado - 70 g (about half a medium avocado)
p: Toast the bread slices in a dry pan or toaster until golden and crispy.
Mash the avocado with a fork and spread evenly over each slice of bread.
Fry the eggs in a small amount of oil. You can leave the yolk runny or cook it through - up to your preference.
Place the eggs on top of the avocado toast.
Add slices of prosciutto on top of the eggs.
Sprinkle with fresh microgreens for crunch and flavor.
Serve with sliced apple, strawberries, and blueberries on the side.

recipes.t: Chicken with Roasted Sweet Potato & Guacamole
i: Garlic powder or granulated garlic - 1 g
Cherry tomatoes - another 80 g (halved or quartered)
p: Chicken
Finely dice the chicken breast.
Mix with olive oil and spices, let marinate for 10-15 minutes.
Sauté in a hot pan for 6-8 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Sweet Potato
Cut into fries or wedges.
Toss with olive oil and seasoning.
Roast in the oven at 200°C for about 25 minutes, flipping once.
Guacamole
Mash the avocado with a fork.
Add diced onion, chopped cherry tomatoes, lemon juice, salt, and herbs. Mix well.
To Serve
Arrange the chicken, roasted sweet potato, and fresh cherry tomatoes on a plate.
Serve guacamole in a small bowl on the side.

i: Optional: a splash of lemon juice
p: Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the spinach and sauté for 1-2 minutes until wilted.
In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs with salt and pepper.
Pour the eggs into the pan with the spinach and gently stir, cooking the scrambled eggs until they reach your preferred consistency.
Slice or mash the avocado and top the scrambled eggs along with the arugula.
Optional: drizzle with a bit of lemon juice for freshness.

recipes.t: Cottage Cheese Bowl with Banana & Kiwi
i: 100-150 g cottage cheese (low-fat, around 5% or less)
2-3 tbsp plain unsweetened yogurt (or Greek yogurt)
p: Place the cottage cheese in a bowl.
Add the yogurt on top or to the side.
Arrange the sliced banana and kiwi neatly.
Sprinkle chia seeds over the top.
Serve immediately and enjoy!

i: 1 can of chickpeas (~250 g), drained and rinsed
Salt, pepper, dried garlic, paprika - to taste
Optional: fresh herbs like parsley, spinach, or basil
p: Cook the quinoa in salted water (1:2 ratio of quinoa to water) for ~15 minutes. Let it cool.
Prepare the chickpeas: rinse well. Optionally, toast in a dry pan with paprika or cumin for extra flavor.
Slice the veggies: shred the carrot, and slice the cucumber and tomatoes.
Assemble the bowl: divide quinoa, chickpeas, and veggies into sections in a large bowl or meal container.
Drizzle the dressing: mix olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and spices, then pour over the bowl.
Top with herbs if using.

recipes.t: Whole Grain Wrap with Hummus, Avocado, Arugula & Egg
i: A handful of arugula or baby spinach
1 boiled egg (soft- or hard-boiled, or poached)
Optional: a squeeze of lemon juice, flax or sesame seeds
p: Warm the tortilla slightly in a dry pan or on a grill (optional).
Spread a generous layer of hummus over the tortilla.
Add sliced avocado.
Top with arugula.
Slice the boiled egg and place it on top.
Season with salt, pepper, and lemon juice if desired.
Fold the tortilla in half or roll it up like a wrap.
Grill lightly on both sides if you want those nice crispy lines and a warm inside.

i: Bell pepper - 200 g (100 g per serving)
Olive oil - 1.5 to 2 tbsp (≈20 g total)
Salt, pepper, herbs - to taste (e.g., rosemary, oregano, paprika)
Grated cheese (like parmesan, mozzarella, gouda, or feta*) - 40-50 g total (20-25 g per serving)
If using feta, don't bake it - just crumble on top before serving.
p: Preheat your oven to 200°C.
Wash and cut the potatoes into wedges, the zucchini into slices, and the bell pepper into strips.
In a large bowl, toss the vegetables with olive oil, salt, pepper, and herbs.
Spread them out on a baking tray lined with parchment paper.
Roast for about 30-35 minutes, flipping once halfway.
Five minutes before the end, sprinkle grated cheese over the top and return to the oven until melted or lightly golden (depending on the cheese).
Serve warm.

recipes.t: Green Smoothie with Apple, Kiwi, Spinach & Cucumber
i: Water or plant-based milk (e.g. almond, coconut) - 150-200 ml
Ice cubes - optional (or use chilled ingredients)
p: Chop the apple, kiwi, and cucumber into smaller pieces.
Add everything to a blender.
Pour in the water (or milk), add lemon juice and ice if using.
Blend until smooth and creamy - about 30-60 seconds.
Taste and adjust: you can add more lemon juice or a touch of honey/maple syrup if you'd like it sweeter.

i: Extra virgin olive oil - 2 tbsp (≈20 ml)
Salt - to taste (careful, feta and olives are already salty)
p: Cut the tomatoes into large chunks.
Slice the cucumber into half-moons or cubes.
Cut the bell pepper into strips or bite-sized pieces.
Slice the red onion thinly (you can soak it in lemon juice or hot water for 5 minutes to mellow the flavor, if you prefer).
Cube the feta cheese.
Combine all the vegetables in a bowl, add the olives and feta.
Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with oregano, and season with a little salt and pepper.

i: Honey / erythritol / date syrup - 1 tsp (≈5 g)
p: Make the dough
Mix oat flour, almond flour, and baking powder.
Add yogurt, egg white, and sweetener.
Knead a soft dough. If too sticky, add a bit more oat flour.
Form into a disk and chill in the fridge for 10 minutes.
Prepare the filling
Slice the nectarine thinly.
Toss with erythritol and cornstarch to absorb excess juice.
Assemble
Roll out the dough into a round (~18-20 cm diameter).
Place nectarine slices in the center, leaving a ~2-3 cm border.
Fold the edges over slightly, pinching as needed.
Brush the crust with egg yolk or yogurt and sprinkle with almond flakes.
Bake
Preheat oven to 180°C / 180°C.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Nutrition per 1 portion (approx. 130-150 g) + Tea

recipes.t: Breakfast Bowl with Eggs, Avocado & Toast
i: 2 slices of bread (rye or whole grain)
2-3 slices of halloumi cheese (or any firm cheese suitable for frying)
3-4 tbsp baked beans in tomato sauce
p: Toast the bread - in a toaster or on a dry skillet until golden and crispy.
Make scrambled eggs - whisk the eggs, season with a pinch of salt, and cook over low heat, stirring gently until creamy and soft (you can use a bit of butter or olive oil).
Fry the halloumi - cook on a non-stick pan for 1-2 minutes per side until golden brown.
Heat the beans - warm them up in a small pan or microwave.
Slice the avocado - season with a pinch of salt and optionally sprinkle with seeds.
Assemble the bowl - place the scrambled eggs, beans, avocado, and halloumi in a bowl. Add arugula on top and serve with toasted bread on the side.

i: Ravioli (spinach & ricotta or similar) - 300 g total (150 g per portion)
Burrata cheese - 125 g total (~60 g per portion)
Cherry tomatoes - 200 g total (100 g per portion)
Fresh arugula (rocket) - 50 g total (25 g per portion)
Olive oil (extra virgin) - 2 tbsp total (1 tbsp per portion)
Balsamic glaze - 2 tsp total (1 tsp per portion)
Salt & freshly ground black pepper - to taste
p: Cook the ravioli
Boil salted water and cook the ravioli for 3-4 minutes or according to the package instructions. Drain carefully.
Prepare the salad
While the ravioli is cooking, halve the cherry tomatoes and mix with fresh arugula. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper. Finish with balsamic glaze.
Plate it up
Divide the ravioli between two plates.
Add the salad to the side.
Place half a burrata (or ~60 g) in the center or on top.
Optionally: Finish with extra black pepper on the burrata for extra flavor.

recipes.t: Dinner Bowl with Tuna, Millet & Steamed Vegetables
i: 160-200 g canned tuna (in water or olive oil)
Salt and black pepper to taste
Optional: lemon juice, fresh herbs like dill or parsley
p: Cook the millet

Rinse the millet thoroughly under running water. Add it to a pot with 250 ml of water and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer covered for about 15 minutes, or until the water is absorbed and the millet is fluffy. Let it rest for 5 minutes.
Steam the vegetables
Steam the broccoli and zucchini for 5-7 minutes until tender but still bright. Season with salt and pepper.
Prepare the tuna
