Drain the tuna. You can leave it plain or mix it with a little olive oil, lemon juice, and chopped herbs if you like.
Assemble the bowls
Divide the millet between two bowls. Add the steamed vegetables and the tuna. Top with halved cherry tomatoes. Drizzle a little olive oil on top, and season with extra black pepper if desired.

i: 1 tbsp sliced or chopped almonds (lightly toasted if preferred)
A few drops of lemon juice (optional, to brighten the berries)
1 tsp honey or maple syrup (optional, if you want a hint of sweetness)
p: Prepare the base
In a small pot, combine oats, milk, and water. Bring to a gentle boil over medium heat.
Simmer the oats
Reduce the heat to low and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the oats are soft and creamy. Add cinnamon and vanilla in the last minute of cooking.
Prep the berries
If using frozen berries, you can warm them slightly in a pan or microwave with a few drops of lemon juice. If fresh - just rinse and pat dry.
Assemble the bowl
Pour the cooked oatmeal into a serving bowl. Top with raspberries, mixed berries, and almonds. Sprinkle chia seeds on top.
Optional finish
Drizzle with a little honey or maple syrup if desired, but it's naturally sweet from the berries.

i: 50-70 g cheese (feta, cottage cheese, mozzarella, or farmer's cheese)
A handful of greens (arugula, spinach, parsley, dill, etc.)
1-2 tbsp Greek yogurt or hummus (for spread)
A few drops of lemon juice or balsamic vinegar
p: Prepare the ingredients
Dice or crumble the cheese.
Slice the tomato and other veggies.
Wash and dry the greens.
Slice the avocado (if using).
Assemble the wrap
Spread yogurt or hummus on one side of the flatbread.
Add greens, veggies, and cheese.
Season with salt, pepper, and a bit of lemon juice or balsamic.
Toast it
Roll up tightly like a burrito or shawarma.
Toast on a dry pan or grill for 1-2 minutes on each side until crispy.
Serve
Cut in half and enjoy with your coffee or tea.

i: 2 medium potatoes (about 300-350 g) - roasted or pan-fried
1/2 head iceberg lettuce or any fresh greens
Optional: lemon juice or apple cider vinegar for extra flavor
p: Cook the potatoes
Dice and roast or pan-fry them with a bit of olive oil, salt, and pepper until golden and tender.
Prepare the chicken
Slice cooked chicken breast into bite-size pieces. (Boiled, baked, or grilled works great.)
Make the salad
Chop lettuce, cucumber, green onion, and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Toss with a drizzle of olive oil, salt, and optional lemon juice.
Assemble the bowls
Divide everything evenly into two bowls: potatoes, chicken, and salad.
Cook the rice according to package instructions.
In a large pan, lightly sauté the vegetables (fresh or frozen) in 1 tsp of olive oil for 5-7 minutes.
Add the cooked rice to the pan and mix well.
Season with salt, pepper, and optionally garlic or herbs.
Cook for another 2-3 minutes on medium heat.

i: A pinch of turmeric or your favorite spices
2 crispbread slices (e.g., rye or whole grain)
p: Egg Whites
Separate the egg whites from the yolks (use 4-5 whites).
Whisk lightly with a pinch of salt and turmeric.
Cook in a non-stick pan without oil (or with a drop of olive oil) for 2-3 minutes, stirring gently until fully set.
Salad
Dice the cucumber, tomato, and bell pepper.
Toss with spinach leaves, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Add a splash of lemon juice or vinegar if desired.
Assembly
Place the scrambled egg whites, tuna, and salad on a plate.
Add two crispbreads on the side.

i: Tomato paste - 1 tbsp (or 1 grated fresh tomato)
Salt, pepper, bay leaf - to taste
p: Bulgur
Rinse the bulgur, add water in a 1:2 ratio.
Cook over medium heat for 10-12 minutes until tender. Add salt and a little olive oil if desired.
Braised cabbage
Shred the cabbage, grate the carrot, and finely chop the onion.
Sauté the onion and carrot in 1 tsp of oil until soft.
Add the cabbage, tomato paste or grated tomato, a splash of water, and spices. Cover with a lid.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes over medium heat until the cabbage is soft and flavorful.
Serving
Plate the bulgur, top or side with braised cabbage, and add fresh cucumber sticks.

i: 1/2 orange or 1/2 mango (or any juicy fruit)
A handful of grapes or berries (strawberries, blueberries, etc.)
Optional: 1 tsp honey or a spoon of plain yogurt
p: Wash all the fruits.
Cut the apple, banana, kiwi, and orange/mango into bite-sized pieces.
Add grapes or berries.
Drizzle with lemon juice and optionally add honey or yogurt.
Gently mix and serve in small bowls or glasses.

recipes.t: Baked Stuffed Peppers with Cheese & Zucchini
i: 60-80 g hard cheese, grated (e.g. mozzarella, gouda, cheddar)
Fresh herbs (parsley, dill, basil) - to taste
Salt, pepper, paprika, Italian herbs - to taste
p: Prepare the peppers
Slice peppers in half lengthwise or cut off the tops ("lids").
Remove seeds and inner membranes.
Make the filling
Grate the zucchini (no need to peel if it's young).
Mix together the cottage cheese, grated hard cheese, zucchini, tomato, onion, garlic, and herbs.
Add olive oil and season with salt, pepper, and spices.
If the filling seems watery, let it sit 5-10 minutes and drain excess liquid.
Stuff the peppers
Fill each pepper generously with the cheese mixture.
Optionally sprinkle a little more grated cheese on top.
Bake
Place peppers in a baking dish. Add a few tablespoons of water or vegetable broth to the bottom to prevent burning.
Cover with foil and bake at 180°C for 30-35 minutes.
Uncover and bake an additional 5-10 minutes until golden on top.
Serving
Serve warm with a side of salad or a spoon of plain yogurt or Greek yogurt.

recipes.t: Cottage Cheese Bowl with Mango and Blueberries
i: 150-200 g of cottage cheese (you can use low-fat or full-fat)
A handful of fresh or frozen blueberries
Optional: 1 tsp honey or Jerusalem artichoke syrup for sweetness
p: Place the cottage cheese in a bowl. For a creamier texture, you can blend it.
Add the diced mango on top.
Add the blueberries.
If you like it sweeter, drizzle with honey or your preferred sweetener.
Enjoy immediately while it's fresh and juicy!

recipes.t: Single-Serving Omelet with Avocado, Tomato, Arugula & Feta
i: 1-2 tbsp crumbled feta or goat cheese
p: Whisk the eggs with a little salt, pepper, and milk/water if desired.
Heat a small pan over medium heat, add the oil or butter.
Pour in the eggs and cook for about 1-2 minutes, until just set underneath.
Place the avocado, tomato, arugula, and cheese on one half of the omelet.
Fold the omelet gently over the filling and cook for another 30-60 seconds.
Slide onto a plate, garnish with a few extra arugula leaves or cheese if you like.
Finish with One Fruit

recipes.t: Chicken Stir-Fry with Bell Peppers, Broccoli & Rice
i: 1 chicken breast, sliced into thin strips
1 tsp sesame oil or any neutral oil
180 g uncooked jasmine or basmati rice
p: Cook the rice
Rinse the rice, then cook with 480 ml of water until tender (about 12-15 minutes).
Fluff with a fork and set aside.
Steam or blanch the broccoli
In boiling water or a steamer for 2-3 minutes, until just tender but still bright green.
Drain and set aside.
Cook the chicken
Heat half the oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add chicken strips, season with a pinch of salt and pepper, and cook until golden and fully cooked (5-6 minutes).
Remove from the pan and set aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables
Add the rest of the oil to the pan.
Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger for 1-2 minutes.
Add bell peppers and cook until slightly softened (3-4 minutes).
Combine everything
Return the chicken to the pan.
Add soy sauce and broccoli, stir well, and cook for another 1-2 minutes until warmed through.
Serve
Plate the rice, then top with the stir-fry mix.
Optionally garnish with sesame seeds, green onions, or a drizzle of extra soy sauce.

i: 240 ml water or your choice of milk (almond, oat, etc.)
Honey or maple syrup to taste (optional)
p: Place the spinach, apple, banana, and kiwi into a blender.
Add the water or milk.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
If you want a colder smoothie, add a few ice cubes and blend again.
Taste and add honey or maple syrup if you prefer it sweeter.
Pour into a glass and enjoy immediately!

i: 120 g mixed greens (lettuce, spinach, arugula, or your favorite)
Optional: handful of fresh cilantro or parsley for garnish
p: In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, mango, cucumber, bell pepper, red onion, and cherry tomatoes.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently to combine.
Garnish with fresh cilantro or parsley if you like.
Divide into two plates and serve immediately.

recipes.t: Avocado & Egg Toast, Green Tea, and Nuts
i: 2 eggs (soft- or medium-boiled, as in the photo)
Salt, black pepper, chili flakes or paprika (to taste)
p: Mash the avocado in a bowl. Add salt, pepper, and lemon juice if desired. Mix well.
Boil the eggs (6.5-7 minutes for soft-medium center), cool, peel, and slice.
Toast the bread until golden and crispy.
Spread the mashed avocado onto each toast slice. Top with sliced eggs.
Sprinkle with salt, black pepper, and chili flakes or garlic powder if desired.
Serve with a cup of green tea and 8-10 nuts on the side.

recipes.t: Pancakes with Fruit and Honey (Healthy and Light)
i: A little coconut or olive oil for cooking
Fresh fruit or berries (e.g. blueberries, strawberries, peaches, apples)
p: Mash the banana with a fork until smooth.
Add the eggs and beat with a whisk.
Add the oatmeal, cinnamon/vanilla and baking powder. Let the dough rest for 5 minutes.
Heat a non-stick frying pan with a little oil.
Place the dough in small pancakes and cook over medium heat, 1-2 minutes on each side until golden brown.
Serving example
Add your favorite fresh fruit or berries.
Drizzle with 1 teaspoon of honey.
Add a spoonful of Greek yogurt, if desired.
Serve with green tea or black coffee (without sugar).

i: 100 g turkey bacon or lean pancetta, diced
50 g grated Parmesan cheese (or Pecorino Romano)
100 ml low-fat milk or unsweetened almond milk
Salt and black pepper to taste
p: Cook the whole wheat spaghetti in salted boiling water according to package instructions until al dente. Reserve about 120 ml of pasta water, then drain the pasta.
In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, grated cheese, milk, salt, and a generous amount of black pepper. Set aside.
In a large pan, cook the diced turkey bacon over medium heat until crispy. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Remove the pan from heat. Quickly add the hot pasta to the pan with the bacon and garlic, then pour the egg and cheese mixture over it.
Toss everything together quickly, adding some reserved pasta water little by little to create a creamy sauce (without scrambling the eggs).
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.

recipes.t: Baked Potatoes, Asparagus, and Fish Fillet
i: 300 g fish fillet (e.g., cod, pike-perch, or salmon)
Salt and black pepper to taste
1 tsp dried herbs (oregano, basil, or thyme)
Fresh parsley or dill for garnish
p: Preheat the oven to 200°C.

Wash the potatoes well and cut into cubes or slices. Place them on a baking tray, drizzle with 1 tbsp olive oil, season with salt, pepper, and dried herbs. Toss to coat evenly. Bake for 25-30 minutes until golden and crispy.
Wash the asparagus and trim the tough ends. Lightly coat with olive oil and season with salt. Add the asparagus to the baking tray with potatoes about 10 minutes before the potatoes are done.
Season the fish fillet with salt, pepper, lemon juice, and lemon zest. Let it marinate for 5 minutes.

Place the fish on a separate baking tray or in a baking dish lightly greased with olive oil. Bake in the oven for 15-20 minutes (depending on fillet thickness) until the fish is tender and flakes easily with a fork.
Serve the baked potatoes, asparagus, and fish together, garnished with fresh herbs.

recipes.t: Chia Pudding with Oatmeal, Raspberries & Granola
i: For chia pudding (prepare the night before)
p: The night before: Mix the chia seeds with milk and honey. Stir well and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning: Cook the oatmeal - bring water or milk to a boil, add the oats, and simmer for 3-5 minutes until soft.
In a bowl, layer the following
Cooked oatmeal
Chia pudding
Fresh raspberries
Granola (on top or on the side)
Optional: Add a drizzle of honey, some seeds, or coconut flakes on top.

recipes.t: Buckwheat with Eggs, Avocado & Fresh Cabbage Salad
i: Sauce of your choice (e.g. mustard + a little ketchup, or Greek yogurt)
p: Buckwheat: Rinse and cook in 480 ml of water with a pinch of salt. Simmer for 15-20 minutes until tender.
Eggs: Boil until hard (about 8-10 minutes), cool, peel, and cut into halves or quarters.
Avocado: Slice or cube, lightly salt, and optionally drizzle with lemon juice.
Salad: Shred the cabbage, cut the tomatoes into wedges, and mix together. Season with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Assemble each plate with portions of buckwheat, eggs, avocado with sauce, and the fresh salad.

recipes.t: Dinner Salad with Halloumi, Avocado & Cucumber
i: Halloumi cheese - 150 g (or substitute with firm feta or bryndza)
p: Grill the cheese
Cut halloumi into cubes and grill or pan-fry on a dry skillet over medium heat for 1-2 minutes per side, until golden.
Prep the veggies
Slice avocado thinly.
Peel the cucumber into ribbons using a vegetable peeler.
Halve the cherry tomatoes (or leave them whole if small).
Assemble the salad
In a large bowl or plate, arrange a base of arugula.
Top with cucumber ribbons, avocado slices, cherry tomatoes, and grilled cheese cubes.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper.

i: A handful of mixed salad greens (e.g. arugula, iceberg, radicchio)
Dried herbs (e.g. oregano or Italian mix), to taste
p: Toast the bread lightly if desired.
Spread cream cheese over each slice.
Add prosciutto on top of the cream cheese.
Fry the egg to your liking (sunny-side-up in the photo) and sprinkle with herbs.
Arrange salad and cucumbers on the plate.
Optionally drizzle the salad with a bit of olive oil or lemon juice.
Serve everything together with a cup of tea or coffee.

i: A bit of cheese or mozzarella (optional)
1 tbsp soft cheese (e.g. cream cheese or ricotta)
1 cup of herbal or green tea (unsweetened)
p: Scrambled Eggs with Spinach
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Lightly sauté spinach in a pan for 1-2 minutes, then pour in the eggs.
Cook over medium heat until set. Sprinkle with cheese if desired.
Avocado Toast
Toast the bread in a toaster or on a pan.
Spread soft cheese on the toast.
Mash the avocado with a fork and spread it on top.
Veggies
Slice the cherry tomatoes.
Nuts & Tea
Add 8 nuts of your choice.
Brew your favorite tea and steep for 3-5 minutes.

i: 2 handfuls of leafy greens (spinach, chard, or lettuce)
2 tsp olive oil (1 tsp for cooking, 1 tsp for dressing)
Salt, pepper, lemon juice - to taste
p: Cook the quinoa
Rinse 170 g of quinoa under cold water.
Cook with 480 ml of water. Simmer for ~15 minutes until water is absorbed and quinoa is fluffy.
Cook the chicken
Season the chicken cubes with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a pan. Cook the chicken on medium heat for ~6-8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden and fully cooked.
Prepare the vegetables
Dice avocado, chop leafy greens and tomatoes.
Toss with 1 tsp olive oil, a squeeze of lemon juice, and a pinch of salt.
Assemble the bowls
Divide quinoa, chicken, and veggies evenly between two bowls.
Serve immediately or store in airtight containers for meal prep.

i: Salt, pepper, dried herbs (e.g. oregano, thyme) - to taste
p: Prepare the mashed potatoes
Peel and chop potatoes into chunks.
Boil in salted water for ~15-20 minutes until soft.
Drain, then mash with butter and warm milk.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Roast the vegetables
Preheat oven to 200°C.
Cut all vegetables into similar-sized chunks.
Toss with olive oil, salt, pepper, and herbs.
Spread on a baking tray and roast for 25-30 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and tender.
Serve
Plate mashed potatoes and top or serve alongside the roasted vegetables.
Optional: add a drizzle of olive oil or sprinkle of nutritional yeast or Parmesan on top.

i: 2 slices of dark rye or whole grain bread
2 slices of cheese (e.g. mozzarella or gouda)
A handful of fresh lettuce or arugula
1 small can of tuna in water or olive oil (drained)
p: Prepare the sandwich base
Lay the bread slices on a plate. Top each slice with a piece of cheese and some lettuce or arugula.
Add the tuna
Flake the tuna with a fork and distribute it evenly over the sandwiches.
Boil the egg
Boil the egg until hard or medium (about 7-9 minutes). Peel and cut in half.
Slice the vegetables
Slice the cucumber and red bell pepper.
Assemble the plate
Place the sandwiches on one side of the plate. Add the sliced cucumber, red bell pepper, and boiled egg on the side.
Optional
Season with a bit of salt and pepper if desired.

recipes.t: Lean Chicken Plate with Brown Rice, Broccoli, Cucumber & Cherry Tomatoes
i: Optional: garlic powder, paprika, chili flakes
p: Cook the rice
Rinse 120 g of brown rice under cold water.
Add to a pot with 2.5x water (about 300 ml).
Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for ~30-35 minutes until tender. Drain if needed.
Cook the chicken
Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized cubes.
Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a non-stick pan.
Add the chicken, season with salt, pepper, and optional spices.
Cook on medium heat for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until fully cooked.
Steam or boil the broccoli
Cut into florets and steam/boil for ~5-6 minutes until bright green and tender but not mushy.
Season lightly with salt or a squeeze of lemon juice.
Prepare the veggies
Slice the cucumber.
Halve the cherry tomatoes.
Assemble the plates
Divide rice, chicken, and broccoli evenly onto two plates.
Add fresh cucumber slices and cherry tomatoes on the side.

i: 1 tsp honey or Jerusalem artichoke syrup (optional)
Optional: pinch of vanilla or cinnamon
p: Prepare the strawberries
Wash and slice the strawberries. You can cut a few in half and press them against the inside of the glass for a decorative look.
Assemble the dessert
Divide the Greek yogurt between two glasses (150 g each).
Add sliced strawberries on top.
Drizzle with honey or syrup if desired. You can also add a touch of vanilla or cinnamon for extra flavor.
Garnish
Top with fresh mint leaves. You may also sprinkle with crushed nuts or coconut flakes if it fits your calorie goals.
Optional - Chill
Place in the fridge for 10-15 minutes before serving to let the flavors blend and enhance.

recipes.t: Protein Salad with Jamón, Poached Egg & Chickpeas
i: 4 slices of Jamón Serrano or Prosciutto (~50 g)
1 tsp balsamic vinegar or lemon juice
Optional: a few parmesan shavings or pumpkin seeds for crunch
p: Prepare the eggs (poached)
Bring water to a gentle simmer in a saucepan.
Add a splash of vinegar (optional, helps keep egg shape).
Crack one egg into a small bowl, swirl the water, and gently drop the egg in.
Poach for ~3 minutes, remove with a slotted spoon. Repeat with the second egg.
Assemble the salad
In a large bowl, mix arugula, cherry tomatoes, avocado slices, and chickpeas.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic (or lemon juice), toss gently.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Plate the dish
Divide salad between two plates.
Drape slices of jamón on top.
Place one poached egg in the center of each salad.
Sprinkle with seeds or parmesan if using.

i: 150 ml water or unsweetened plant-based milk (e.g. almond, oat, soy)
50-70 g fresh or frozen berries (blueberries, raspberries, strawberries etc.)
Optional toppings: chia seeds, nuts, coconut flakes, cinnamon
p: Cook the oats
In a small saucepan, combine oats, water (or plant milk), and a pinch of salt.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Sweeten naturally (optional)
Mash in half a banana during the last minute of cooking for natural sweetness - or skip it for a more neutral flavor.
Add the berries
If using frozen berries, you can stir them into the pot in the last minute to warm them.
If using fresh berries, just add them on top when serving.
Top and serve
Pour the oatmeal into a bowl.
Add your berries and optional toppings like a sprinkle of chia seeds, a few crushed nuts, or a pinch of cinnamon.

i: Hemp seeds or sesame seeds for garnish
p: Prepare the vegetable noodles
Use a spiralizer or a vegetable peeler to create thin strips from the zucchini and yellow squash.
Make the nests
Heat a little olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Form two small "nests" from the veggie strips in the pan.
Add the eggs
Crack one egg into the center of each nest.
Cook until the egg whites are set but the yolk is still runny (or to your desired doneness). You can cover the pan with a lid to help the eggs cook evenly.
Prepare the avocado
Slice the avocado thinly and fan it out on the plate.
Assemble and season
Transfer the zucchini egg nests to a plate. Add the sliced avocado.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper, chili flakes, and hemp seeds.

recipes.t: Chicken & Veggie Noodles with Fresh Salad
i: 1 tbsp olive oil or coconut oil
Dried herbs (oregano, basil, or parsley) for garnish
p: Prepare the noodles
Cook rice noodles according to package instructions, drain, and set aside.
Cook the chicken and vegetables
Heat olive oil in a pan. Add chicken and cook until lightly browned.
Add onion, carrot, peas, and bell pepper. Stir-fry for about 5-7 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Add soy sauce, pepper, and lemon juice. Toss in the noodles and mix well.
Prepare the salad
Arrange lettuce, cucumber, and tomato on plates. Sprinkle dried herbs on top.
Serve
Divide the noodle stir-fry and salad evenly into two plates.

i: 150 g mixed berries (fresh or frozen - blueberries, strawberries, raspberries, etc.)
150 ml unsweetened almond milk (or other milk of choice)
1 tsp chia seeds (optional, for extra fiber)
1 tsp honey or maple syrup (optional, if you prefer it sweeter)
p: Place all ingredients into a blender.
Blend on high speed until smooth and creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy immediately.
Tip: If you want it thicker and creamier, use frozen berries and a frozen banana.

i: 150 g canned tuna in its own juice (drain the liquid)
4 leaves of lettuce (iceberg or romaine), chopped
p: Boil the eggs to your preferred doneness, cool, and cut in half.
In a large bowl, combine chopped lettuce, cucumber, and cherry tomatoes.
Add chunks of tuna.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, season with salt and pepper.
Place the eggs on top and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

recipes.t: Omelette with Fresh Vegetables and Herbs
i: Fresh dill and parsley (or your favorite herbs)
1 tsp olive oil or butter for frying
p: In a bowl, whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add olive oil or butter.
Pour in the eggs and cook until set, without flipping.
Place cucumber slices and fresh herbs on one half of the omelette.
Fold the omelette in half and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve warm.
Drink suggestion: Enjoy with a cup of black coffee or green tea.

recipes.t: Chicken & Potato Bowl with Fresh Salad
i: A handful of mixed salad leaves
A pinch of salt and fresh herbs to taste
p: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Place diced potatoes and chicken in a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt, pepper, and herbs. Mix well and bake for 25-30 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Prepare the fresh salad by arranging bell pepper, tomatoes, and salad leaves on the plate.
Make the cabbage-corn salad by mixing cabbage, cucumber, corn, yogurt, and seasonings in a bowl.
Divide baked potatoes and chicken between two plates, add both salads, and serve immediately.
Pair with still water

i: 2 large handfuls of mixed greens (arugula, beet leaves, spinach, etc.)
2 tsp lemon juice or balsamic vinegar
p: Wash and dry the greens. Place them in a large salad bowl.
Dice the tomatoes and add them to the greens.
Add the mozzarella balls.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice (or balsamic vinegar).
Season with salt and pepper, toss gently, and serve immediately.

i: Lemon juice or balsamic vinegar - a little, for dressing
p: Buckwheat. Rinse well, add 240 ml of water, a pinch of salt. Cook covered for 15-18 minutes until tender.
Chicken. Cut chicken breast into pieces, season with salt and pepper. Pan-fry in a dry skillet or with 1/2 tbsp of olive oil until golden (7-10 minutes).
Salad. Chop tomatoes, cucumber, avocado, lettuce, and onion. Dress with olive oil and lemon juice/vinegar.
Plate the meal: buckwheat + chicken + salad.

i: Fresh herbs (parsley or dill) - for garnish
p: If using dried chickpeas, soak them overnight and cook until tender (about 40 minutes). If using canned chickpeas, simply rinse and drain.
Chop the cucumber, tomatoes, and onion.
Combine the vegetables with chickpeas and greens in a bowl.
Dress with olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Top with feta cheese cubes and sprinkle with fresh herbs.

i: Lavash (flatbread) - 1 sheet (about 1/2 of a standard one)
p: Spread cream cheese evenly over the lavash.
Layer with sliced avocado, tomato, greens, and pumpkin seeds.
Add prosciutto on top.
Roll tightly into a wrap.
Serve as is, or lightly toast on a dry skillet/grill pan until the lavash is crispy.

i: Salt, black pepper, dried oregano or basil - to taste
2 boiled eggs (hard- or soft-boiled, as you prefer)
A handful of nuts (walnuts, almonds, or cashews)
p: Toast the bread slices in a toaster or on a dry pan.
Mash the avocado with a fork, add a little salt and pepper, and spread it over the toasts.
Cut the cherry tomatoes in half and place them on top of the avocado along with the mozzarella balls.
Sprinkle with dried herbs and black pepper.
Peel the boiled eggs and serve them whole or cut in half.
Add a handful of nuts on the side.
Enjoy with a cup of hot green tea.

i: 150 g Greek yogurt (or plain natural yogurt, unsweetened)
A handful of berries (raspberries, blueberries, strawberries)
1 tsp honey or Jerusalem artichoke syrup (optional)
p: The night before, mix chia seeds with milk, stir well, and let sit in the fridge overnight (or at least 2-3 hours).
In the morning, layer the glass: yogurt at the bottom, then fruit, then the chia pudding.
Add berries on top, sprinkle with nuts and coconut flakes.
Drizzle with a bit of honey if you like.

i: 1 can tuna in water (≈ 200 g drained)
100 g light mozzarella (or 125 g regular, divided into 2 portions)
Salt, pepper, lemon juice - to taste
p: Cook the rice and divide it into two bowls.
Add tuna on top.
Cut or tear mozzarella into small pieces and add to each bowl.
Slice the cucumber, add cherry tomatoes and leafy greens.
Season with salt, pepper, a drizzle of olive oil, and lemon juice.

i: Salt, black pepper, dried herbs (oregano, basil, thyme) - to taste
A few walnut pieces (optional, for topping)
p: Peel and chop the carrots into cubes or half-moons.
In a pan, sauté the carrots and onion in olive oil for 3-4 minutes.
Add zucchini, bell pepper, and garlic, cook for another few minutes.
Stir in the tomatoes and broth, cover with a lid.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes, until the carrots are tender but not mushy.
Season with salt, pepper, and herbs.
Serve hot, sprinkled with fresh herbs, walnuts (optional), and grated Parmesan on top.

i: 1/2 avocado (sliced, sprinkle with black sesame seeds if you like)
p: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Heat a non-stick pan (add a drop of olive oil if needed).
Add spinach and tomato, cook for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and gently scramble until fluffy.
On a plate, arrange scrambled eggs, avocado, apple, pear, and berries.
Sprinkle avocado with sesame seeds if desired.

recipes.t: Avocado, Cream Cheese & Egg Crispbread Breakfast
i: A handful of arugula or other greens
Salt and black pepper - to taste
A few drops of lemon juice (optional)
p: Boil the eggs, let them cool slightly, and cut in halves.
Mash the avocado with a fork, season with salt, pepper, and lemon juice.
Spread a thin layer of cream cheese on the crispbreads.
Top with the avocado mixture.
Sprinkle with seeds.
Serve with eggs, tomato, and greens.
Tea

i: 1-2 tbsp olive oil (for mashed potatoes and salad)
A handful of arugula or mixed greens
p: Chicken
Cut the chicken breast into small cubes or strips.
Season with salt, pepper, and your favorite spices.
Pan-fry on a non-stick skillet with minimal oil, or bake in the oven at 180°C (~180°C) for 15-20 minutes.
Mashed potatoes
Boil the potatoes until tender.
Mash them with a little olive oil and some hot water instead of butter/milk (for a lighter, PP-friendly version).
Add salt to taste.
Salad
Chop the tomatoes, cucumbers, and bell pepper.
Add arugula or mixed greens.
Dress with a few drops of olive oil and, optionally, some lemon juice.
Serving
Divide into two plates: a portion of mashed potatoes, fresh salad, and pieces of chicken.

recipes.t: Salad with Burrata, Peach and Tomatoes
i: Mixed salad leaves (arugula, spinach, iceberg) - 100 g
p: Wash and dry the lettuce leaves.
Cut the cherry tomatoes in half.
Cut the peach into slices.
Place the lettuce leaves, greens - tomatoes and peaches on a plate.
Place the burrata in the middle (or tear it into pieces).
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic cream.
Add a little salt and freshly ground black pepper.

recipes.t: Yogurt Bowl with Banana, Berries & Avocado Toast
i: 150-200 g Greek or plain unsweetened yogurt
a handful of berries (raspberries, blueberries, blackberries, or others)
2 slices of whole-grain or rye bread
p: Place yogurt in a bowl.
Add sliced banana, berries, and peanut butter.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Toast the bread slices.
Spread mashed avocado on top, season with salt and spices.
Serve with coffee.

i: 3-4 tbsp pesto sauce (basil, olive oil, pine nuts, Parmesan)
p: Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente. Drain, keeping about 50 ml of the pasta water for the sauce.
Blanch the green beans in boiling water for 3-4 minutes, then drain.
In a pan, heat the olive oil, add spinach (if using), and sauté lightly.
Add the cooked pasta, green beans, pesto, and a splash of the reserved pasta water. Mix well.
Stir in halved cherry tomatoes, season with salt and pepper.
Serve with freshly grated Parmesan.

i: Lemon juice or balsamic vinegar - a splash for freshness
p: Rinse quinoa thoroughly and cook in a 1:2 ratio (quinoa : water) for about 15 minutes until done.
Separate broccoli into florets and boil for 3-4 minutes in salted water or steam until bright and slightly crunchy.
Slice the boiled carrots into rounds or cubes.
Chop the tomatoes (halves if cherry, cubes if regular).
In a pan, lightly sauté garlic in olive oil, then add tomatoes and carrots. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked quinoa and broccoli, season with salt, pepper, and spices.
Before serving, drizzle with lemon juice or balsamic vinegar.
Mash half the banana with a fork until smooth.
Add the egg and mix well.
Stir in oat flour, baking powder, and spices.
Mix until the batter is thick and creamy.
Cook on a non-stick pan over medium heat for 1-2 minutes on each side.
Add fruits at the end: top the cooked pancakes with the remaining banana slices and any berries you like (blueberries, raspberries, strawberries).
Optional: a teaspoon of Greek yogurt for extra creaminess.

i: Salt and black pepper to taste
A drizzle of olive oil or a small piece of butter
p: Preheat oven to 180 °C.
Whisk the eggs with milk, salt, and pepper.
Grease a small baking dish with olive oil or butter.
Pour in the egg mixture.
Place broccoli and tomato halves on top.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, until the eggs are set.
Serve warm.
1 cup of tea (without sugar)
8 nuts (almonds, walnuts, or hazelnuts)

i: Lemon juice, herbs, salt, pepper - to taste
p: Cook couscous
Put couscous in a bowl, pour in twice as much boiling water (about 200 ml).
Cover and leave for 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork.
Prepare vegetables
Dice the avocado.
Cut cherry tomatoes in halves or quarters.
Chop herbs (parsley or cilantro).
Assemble salad
Mix couscous with avocado, tomatoes, and herbs.
Season with olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Add tuna
Drain canned tuna well.
Break into chunks and place on top of the salad (or mix in).
Serve
Divide into 2 bowls.
Add 1 plum or apricot per portion for dessert.

recipes.t: Baked Red Fish with Roasted Vegetables
p: Cut vegetables - slice zucchini, carrot, bell pepper, and onion.
Bake vegetables - place them on a baking tray, drizzle with 1 tsp olive oil, season with salt and pepper. Bake at 180 °C for ~20 minutes.
Cook fish - drizzle the fillet with lemon juice, season with salt, pepper, and 1 tsp olive oil. Bake (or pan-fry) for 12-15 minutes until tender.
Serve - divide fish and vegetables onto 2 plates, sprinkle with fresh herbs, and add lemon wedges if desired.

recipes.t: Breakfast Plate with Eggs, Cheese & Avocado
i: 1 tsp olive oil or butter (for toasting)
A handful of mixed nuts (almonds, cashews, peanuts)
p: Boil the eggs for about 6-7 minutes to get a soft yolk.
Toast the bread on a dry pan or with a little butter/olive oil. Add cheese or your favorite filling inside.
Slice the avocado, cucumber, banana, and peach.
Cut the cherry tomatoes in halves.
Arrange everything nicely on a plate: sandwich, eggs, fruits, vegetables, and nuts.

recipes.t: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Chicken, Rice & Cheese
i: Chicken breast - 150 g (cut into small cubes)
Plain yogurt (unsweetened) or light sour cream (5%) - 1 tbsp
Salt, black pepper, paprika, oregano - to taste
p: Cook the rice until half done.
Heat the olive oil in a pan, sauté onion and carrot, then add chicken and cook lightly until golden.
Add tomato, yogurt, and spices. Simmer for 3-4 minutes.
Mix the chicken with the rice.
Stuff the peppers with the mixture and sprinkle with cheese on top.
Place in a baking dish, add a little water to the bottom, and cover with foil.
Bake at 180°C for 30-35 minutes. Remove foil and bake for another 5-7 minutes until cheese is golden.
Grate the zucchini and squeeze out excess liquid.
Mix with the egg, oats (or flour), and seasoning.
Cook small pancakes in a non-stick pan with little or no oil until golden on both sides.
For the sauce, mix yogurt with spices (pepper, garlic, or lemon juice).
Serve pancakes warm with the yogurt dip.

i: 1 tsp chia seeds or hemp seeds
p: Place the yogurt in a bowl.
Add sliced banana and kiwi.
Sprinkle granola on top.
Garnish with blueberries and seeds.
Green Tea

i: Salad mix (arugula, spinach, leafy greens) - 80-100 g
p: Cook the bulgur until tender (about 10-12 minutes).
If using dry chickpeas - soak overnight and cook until soft; if using canned - just rinse.
Prepare the salad: slice cucumber and avocado, mix with the salad greens. Dress with olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Divide into plates: bulgur, a portion of chickpeas, and fresh salad.

recipes.t: Chicken with Vegetables in Soy Sauce
i: Soy sauce (low-sodium, no added sugar) - 2-3 tbsp
p: Cut the chicken into cubes. Sauté in olive oil until golden.
Add sliced carrot and bell pepper, then broccoli (fresh or frozen).
Stir in garlic and ginger.
Pour in soy sauce, stir-fry for another 5-7 minutes until the veggies are tender but still crisp.
Serve hot.

recipes.t: Breakfast Plate with Egg, Cheese & Avocado
i: Cheese (hard or soft, e.g., cream cheese like Philadelphia or a small piece of hard cheese) - 30-50 g
Butter (olive oil) or Philadelphia cheese - optional
p: Egg
Fry it in a pan with minimal oil (or olive oil), or make it poached or boiled.
Bread
Toast the whole grain dark bread slices.
Spread a little Philadelphia cheese or a thin layer of butter/olive oil.
Veggies and avocado
Slice the cucumber and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Slice the avocado and sprinkle with seeds.
Cheese and ham
Slice or spread the cheese on the bread.
Slice the ham thinly; you can lightly sear it or leave it raw.
Plate assembly
Place the cheese and ham on the bread.
On the side, add the egg, vegetables, avocado with seeds, and almonds.
Optionally, drizzle a tiny bit of olive oil over the vegetables.
Drink
Serve with tea or black coffee.

recipes.t: Baked Potato with Chicken & Cheese Filling
i: Low-fat cheese - 40 g (for filling) + 20 g (for topping)
Cream cheese or plain unsweetened yogurt - 50 g
Butter - 5 g or a small amount of olive oil (optional)
Salt, spices (paprika, black pepper, dried herbs) - to taste
p: Wash the potatoes, wrap each in foil, and bake at 180°C for about 1.5 hours.
Meanwhile, prepare the filling
Boil or bake the chicken breast, then finely chop it.
Grate 40 g of low-fat cheese.
Mix with cream cheese (or plain yogurt) and chopped herbs. Stir well.
Once the potatoes are slightly cooled, make a cut in the middle (don't slice all the way through).
Add a little salt, spices, and a small piece of butter (optional), then mash lightly with a fork.
Fill the potatoes with the prepared mixture, sprinkle 20 g of cheese on top, and bake for an additional 10 minutes at 180°C.

i: Water or unsweetened plant-based milk - 100-150 ml (adjust for desired consistency)
p: Peel the kiwi, apple, and pear (you can leave the apple skin on if it's organic).
Cut the fruits into small pieces.
Place all ingredients in a blender, add water or milk.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Optional: add ice and blend again.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

i: Salad greens (lettuce, arugula, or spinach) - 50 g
Salt and black pepper - to taste
p: Wash and dry the salad greens, then tear into bite-sized pieces.
Slice the pear thinly.
Cut the Camembert cheese into small cubes or slices.
Lightly toast the nuts in a dry pan (optional).
For the dressing, mix olive oil, lemon juice, honey (if using), salt, and pepper.
Combine the salad greens, pear, Camembert, and nuts, then drizzle with the dressing and gently toss.

recipes.t: Banana Pancakes with Nuts and Berries
i: Oat flour (or blended oats) - 30 g (≈3 tbsp)
Oil or butter - 1 tsp for frying
p: Mash the banana with a fork until smooth.
Add the egg and mix until well combined.
Stir in oat flour, baking powder, and cinnamon.
Fold in the chopped nuts.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and lightly grease with oil or butter.
Spoon the batter onto the pan, forming small pancakes. Cook 2-3 minutes per side until golden.
Serve topped with fresh berries and extra nuts if desired.

recipes.t: Cottage Cheese with Fruits and Nuts
i: Greek yogurt or plain unsweetened yogurt - 2 tbsp (optional, for creaminess)
Seasonal fruits (apple, pear, kiwi, strawberries, blueberries, raspberries) - 100-120 g
p: Mash cottage cheese with a fork or mix with yogurt until creamy.
Cut fruits into small cubes or slices.
Combine cottage cheese with fruits.
Sprinkle with nuts.
Add a little honey or stevia if you like.
Drink
Green or black tea with a few nuts on the side (5-6 almonds or walnuts).

i: Chicken breast - 100 g (about 50 g per serving, or even less)
Shirataki noodles (or rice noodles, but shirataki are almost calorie-free) - 200 g cooked
A drop of oil for frying (or use a non-stick pan)
p: Cut chicken into small cubes and quickly fry on a dry or lightly oiled pan.
Add chopped vegetables (carrot, pepper, zucchini, broccoli) and garlic, sauté briefly.
Add cooked shirataki noodles (they usually just need rinsing and heating).
Season with soy sauce, ginger, and spices. Mix well.
Serve hot, topped with chopped green onion.

recipes.t: Buckwheat with Chickpeas and Fresh Vegetables
i: Fresh herbs (parsley, dill, basil) - to taste
p: Rinse the buckwheat and cook it in water until tender (10-15 min).
Lightly warm the chickpeas if using canned.
Chop fresh vegetables into small cubes.
Mix buckwheat, chickpeas, and vegetables together. Add herbs, lemon juice, and olive oil.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.t: Quesadilla with Prosciutto, Cheese & Avocado + Salad
i: 40-50 g cheese (mozzarella, provolone, or any light cheese)
50-70 g vegetables for the filling (e.g. zucchini, mushrooms, bell pepper)
A handful of fresh spinach or arugula
A drizzle of balsamic glaze or olive oil
p: Lightly sauté the vegetables in a dry pan (no oil or just a drop).
On half of the tortilla, spread avocado slices, add cheese, prosciutto, and sautéed vegetables.
Fold the tortilla in half and grill it on a dry skillet until golden and crispy on both sides.
Serve with a fresh salad of spinach/arugula, cherry tomatoes, and a touch of balsamic glaze.

recipes.t: Breakfast Plate with Avocado Toast, Scrambled Eggs & Prosciutto
i: 1 slice of whole-grain bread or crispbread
p: Scrambled eggs
Whisk the eggs with milk, salt, and pepper.
Cook gently in a pan with a little olive oil or butter, stirring constantly for a soft scramble.
Toast
Toast the bread in a toaster or on a dry pan.
Mash the avocado with a fork, add a few drops of lemon juice, and season with salt.
Spread the avocado on the toast.
Veggies
Cut the cherry tomatoes in halves.
Toss the arugula lightly with a drizzle of olive oil.
Plating
Place the avocado toast on the plate.
Add a portion of scrambled eggs next to it.
Arrange the arugula and tomatoes on the side.
Fold and place the prosciutto slices neatly.

i: 150 g cooked chicken breast (sliced into thin strips)
A handful of lettuce or spinach leaves
A handful of fresh herbs (mint, cilantro, or basil)
50 g rice noodles (optional, for extra fullness)
A pinch of chili flakes or fresh chili
p: Cook the rice noodles (if using) according to package instructions, drain, and let cool.
Prepare the vegetables: cut carrot, cucumber, and pepper into thin strips.
Slice the cooked chicken breast into thin pieces.
Soften a rice paper wrapper by dipping it in warm water for a few seconds.
Place the wrapper on a plate and layer: a bit of lettuce, noodles, vegetables, herbs, and chicken.
Fold the sides and roll tightly. Repeat with the rest.
Serve fresh with the dipping sauce.

i: Salt and black pepper, to taste
p: Pour boiling water over the couscous (1:1 ratio), cover, and let sit for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork.
Cut zucchini, carrot, bell pepper, and onion into small cubes or strips.
Heat olive oil in a pan, add onion and garlic, and sauté lightly.
Add carrot, bell pepper, and zucchini. Cook for 7-10 minutes until tender.
Stir in chickpeas, season with salt, pepper, and spices. Cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Combine the couscous with the vegetables and chickpeas. Sprinkle with fresh herbs.
Serve with a squeeze of lemon juice.
Cook the oats in milk (or plant-based alternative) over medium heat until soft and creamy.
Transfer the oatmeal into a bowl.
Top with sliced banana, whole almonds, and sprinkle chia seeds on top.
Serve warm and enjoy!

recipes.t: Baked Sweet Potato with Chickpeas, Spinach & Hummus
i: 160 g cooked chickpeas (or canned, drained & rinsed)
Optional: paprika, cumin, garlic powder for chickpeas
p: Preheat oven to 200°C. Wash sweet potatoes, pierce with a fork, and bake for 40-50 minutes until soft.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a pan. Add onion and sauté until soft. Add spinach and cook briefly until wilted.
In another pan, roast chickpeas with spices until golden and slightly crispy.
Cut baked sweet potatoes in half. Top with spinach-onion mixture, roasted chickpeas, and a spoonful of hummus.
Season with salt, pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil if desired.

i: Fresh herbs (parsley, mint, or cilantro) for garnish
p: Rinse quinoa thoroughly, then cook according to package instructions (usually 1:2 ratio with water, simmer for ~15 min).
In a pan, heat olive oil and sauté chicken until golden and fully cooked. Season with salt and pepper.
Add chopped onion and bell pepper, cook for a few minutes until softened.
Mix cooked quinoa with chicken and vegetables. Add cucumber for freshness.
Garnish with fresh herbs and serve warm.

recipes.t: Breakfast Bowl with Boiled Eggs & Avocado
i: A handful of cherry tomatoes, halved
A handful of fresh salad greens (arugula, lettuce, spinach mix)
p: Boil the eggs for about 6-7 minutes so the yolks stay soft. Peel and cut them in halves.
Spread cream cheese over the slice of whole grain bread.
Place salad greens, avocado slices, cherry tomatoes, and cheese on a plate.
Add the boiled eggs and season with salt, pepper, and sesame seeds.
Serve everything in one bowl for a colorful and nutritious breakfast.
Drink: Serve with a cup of hot tea.

i: Spices: garlic powder, black pepper, paprika
A pinch of dried herbs (oregano or basil)
p: Cook the glass noodles according to package instructions, then rinse with cold water.
Heat olive oil in a pan, add chicken breast, and cook until golden.
Add bell pepper and mushrooms, stir-fry for a few minutes.
Add soy sauce, spices, and the cooked noodles. Toss well.
Serve with fresh salad: sliced cucumber, tomatoes, and lettuce. Sprinkle herbs on top.
Garnish the noodles with sesame seeds before serving.

i: 80 g hard cheese (light version or mozzarella works well)
p: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Slice all vegetables into thin rounds, and cut the cheese into slices.
Cut two rectangles of parchment paper and arrange the vegetables and cheese alternately on each (zucchini tomato bell pepper carrot cheese repeat).
Season with salt, pepper, dried herbs, and garlic. Drizzle with olive oil.
Fold the parchment into "boats" and tie the ends securely.
Bake for 25-30 minutes.
Serve directly in parchment, garnished with fresh herbs.

recipes.t: Poached Egg & Avocado Salad with Rice Cake and Cream Cheese
i: Salt and black pepper, to taste
p: Prepare the poached egg: bring water to a gentle simmer, add a splash of vinegar, and poach the egg for 3-4 minutes until the white is set but the yolk remains runny.
On a plate or bowl, arrange arugula and cherry tomatoes.
Add the sliced avocado on top of the greens.
Place the poached egg in the center, season with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Serve with a rice cake spread with cream cheese on the side.

i: Chicken breast - 200 g (100 g per serving)
Salt and black pepper - to taste
p: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips, season with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tsp of olive oil in a non-stick pan, sear the chicken until golden, then set aside.
In the same pan, sauté chopped onion, garlic, carrot, zucchini, and bell pepper until slightly soft.
Add rice, stir well, then pour in chicken broth. Season with turmeric/saffron, salt, and pepper.
Simmer on low heat for about 15-18 minutes, until rice is tender.
Return the chicken to the pan, add cherry tomatoes, and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Sprinkle with fresh herbs before serving.
About 320-350 kcal per serving,

i: A drizzle of olive oil or a small knob of butter (optional, 5 g per serving)
p: Peel the potatoes, cut into chunks, and boil in salted water until tender (about 15 minutes). Drain and toss with chopped dill and a little olive oil or butter.
If using herring: Slice fillet into pieces, serve with onion rings on the side.
If using salad: Mix lettuce, halved cherry tomatoes, and corn. Dress with olive oil, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt.
Serve potatoes hot with your chosen side.

i: 10 g nuts (almonds, walnuts, or hazelnuts - your choice)
Freshly brewed coffee or unsweetened tea
p: Place the cottage cheese and Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Add banana slices and blueberries on top.
Sprinkle with nuts and freeze-dried berries.
Serve with a cup of coffee or tea.

i: 1 small egg (or half a large one, but whole works fine)
1 tbsp oat flour or whole wheat flour
A little chopped green onion or fresh herbs
A few cubes of feta or mozzarella
p: Zucchini fritters
Grate the zucchini, squeeze out excess liquid.
Mix with egg, flour, salt, and pepper.
Fry 2-3 small fritters in a little olive oil until golden.
Assemble the bowl
Place zucchini fritters in a bowl.
Add fresh spinach and halved cherry tomatoes.
Top with cream cheese or ricotta.
Garnish with green onion or herbs.
Optional drink
Blend a quick green smoothie: a handful of spinach, 1/2 apple or kiwi, and a splash of lemon juice.

i: Salt, black pepper, paprika, garlic - to taste
p: Prepare the vegetables.
Cut potatoes into wedges.
Break cauliflower into florets.
Slice peppers into strips and onion into half-rings (optional).
Season.
In a bowl, mix olive oil, salt, pepper, paprika, and garlic.
Toss the vegetables well in this mixture.
Roast.
Place in a baking bag (or on a parchment-lined tray).
Bake at 200°C (~200°C) for 35-40 minutes until golden.
Serve.
Sprinkle with fresh herbs (parsley, dill).

i: 50 ml low-fat kefir or plain unsweetened yogurt
A pinch of cinnamon or vanilla (optional)
40 g low-fat cheese (light mozzarella, feta, or cottage cheese)
2 tbsp plain unsweetened yogurt (as a sauce)
p: Blend oats into flour, then mix with egg, kefir (or yogurt), baking powder, and spices. Let rest for 5 minutes to thicken.
Cook pancakes on a non-stick pan for 1-2 minutes per side, without oil.
Prepare a poached or soft-boiled egg.
Arrange pancakes on a plate with spinach, cheese, egg, and yogurt as a sauce.

recipes.t: Breakfast Plate with Eggs, Jamon & Beans
i: Canned beans in their own juice - 2 tbsp (40 g)
Pickled or fresh cucumber, finely chopped - 2 tbsp
Plain Greek or natural yogurt - 2 tbsp (40 g)
p: Boil the eggs until medium or hard (as you prefer), peel and cut in halves.
Slice the avocado and cherry tomatoes.
Add jamón/prosciutto slices to the plate.
Add beans (rinse if in sauce, or use plain).
Add chopped cucumber.
Serve with a spoon of yogurt as a dip.
Enjoy with black coffee or tea.

recipes.t: Baked Apples with Cottage Cheese, Honey, and Nuts + Tea
i: 1 tbsp chopped walnuts (or any nuts you like)
p: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Wash the apple, cut off the top, and scoop out the core, creating a small cavity.
In a small bowl, mix the cottage cheese with honey and cinnamon.
Fill the apple cavity with the cottage cheese mixture.
Sprinkle chopped nuts on top.
Place the apple in a baking dish and bake for 15-20 minutes, until the apple is tender but still holds its shape.
Serve warm with a cup of your favorite tea and enjoy!

i: 160 g cooked chickpeas (or canned, drained and rinsed)
60 g mixed salad greens (lettuce, arugula, spinach)
Optional: fresh herbs (parsley, cilantro, or dill)
p: Cook bulgur according to package instructions. Let it cool slightly.
In a bowl, mix bulgur and chickpeas.
In a separate bowl, prepare the salad: combine salad greens, cucumber, carrot, cherry tomatoes, and bell pepper.
Make a light dressing with olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Toss the salad with the dressing.
Serve half of the bulgur-chickpea mixture with half of the salad. Repeat for the second serving the next day.
Optional: sprinkle fresh herbs on top for extra flavor.
Tip: You can add 1 boiled egg or 50 g of feta cheese per portion for more protein if you like.

i: 200 g chicken breast, cut into small cubes
120 ml low-sodium vegetable or chicken broth
Salt, pepper, paprika, or other spices to taste
p: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add onion and garlic, sauté until soft.
Add chicken cubes and cook until lightly browned.
Add carrot, bell pepper, and zucchini (if using). Cook 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add broccoli and pour in the broth. Cover and simmer 8-10 minutes, until all vegetables are tender and chicken is cooked through.
Season with salt, pepper, and spices to taste.
Serve half the stew for dinner today. Keep the second half in the fridge for the next day. Reheat gently before serving.
Optional: sprinkle fresh herbs on top for extra flavor.
Tip: You can add a small portion of quinoa, brown rice, or cauliflower rice for a more filling meal without adding too many calories.

recipes.t: Oatmeal with Fruits, Nuts & Boiled Egg
i: Milk or water - 200 ml (or half and half)
p: Cook the oats in milk/water until soft (about 5-7 minutes).
Add a little cinnamon or vanilla if you like.
Transfer the oatmeal to a bowl.
Top with sliced banana, blueberries, and chopped walnuts.
Add 1 boiled egg (cut in halves or slices on the side).

recipes.t: Fried Egg with Avocado & Arugula Salad
i: Dried herbs (oregano, basil, or Italian mix) - optional
p: Fry the egg on a pan (sunny side up or your preferred style). Season with salt and pepper.
For the salad: wash the arugula and place it on a plate.
Add halved cherry tomatoes and sliced avocado.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with herbs.
Serve the egg alongside the fresh salad.

i: 1 small broccoli, cut into small florets
200 g chicken breast, baked and finely chopped
Optional: garlic, paprika, or your favorite spices
p: Prepare the couscous
Bring 200 ml of water or chicken broth to a boil.
Place the couscous in a bowl and pour the hot liquid over it.
Cover and let it sit for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Cook the vegetables
In a pan, heat 1 tbsp of olive oil over medium heat.
Add diced carrot and bell pepper, sauté for 3-4 minutes.
Add broccoli florets and cook for another 3-5 minutes until tender but still crisp.
Prepare the chicken
Bake chicken breast (seasoned with salt, pepper, and optional spices) at 180°C for 20-25 minutes or until fully cooked.
Let it cool slightly, then chop finely.
Combine everything
Mix the cooked couscous, sautéed vegetables, and chopped chicken in a large bowl.
Adjust seasoning with salt, pepper, and spices.
Storage for two days
Divide into two airtight containers.
Store in the fridge for up to 2 days.
Reheat gently in a microwave or on a pan before eating.

i: 100 g grilled chicken breast, thinly sliced
2 small tomatoes or 6-8 cherry tomatoes, halved
1 small cucumber, sliced (optional, for extra volume)
2 whole-wheat croutons (or 4 small ones per serving)
p: Prepare the chicken
Season chicken breast lightly with salt, pepper, and optional paprika.
Grill or pan-cook for 5-7 minutes per side until fully cooked.
Let cool slightly, then slice thinly.
Make the dressing
In a small bowl, mix Greek yogurt, Dijon mustard, olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Assemble the salad
In a large bowl, combine chopped romaine, tomatoes, cucumber, and croutons.
Add sliced chicken.
Drizzle with dressing and toss gently.
Sprinkle with grated Parmesan.
Serving & storage
Serve immediately for best texture.
If preparing for later, store components separately (lettuce, dressing, chicken) in the fridge and combine just before eating to avoid soggy lettuce.

recipes.t: Cottage Cheese Crepes with Fruit and Honey
i: 25 g (about 3 tbsp) oat or whole-grain flour
A few drops of olive oil or non-stick spray for cooking
A few drops of vanilla extract (optional)
1/2 small banana or a handful of berries (about 50-70 g)
p: Make the batter: Whisk the egg, milk, flour, and salt until smooth.
Cook the crepes: Pour a thin layer of batter onto a non-stick pan and cook on both sides until golden. You'll get about 2-3 small crepes.
Prepare the filling: Mix cottage cheese with vanilla and 1 tsp honey.
Assemble: Spread the filling inside each crepe, roll them up, and top with fruit and a drizzle of honey.

recipes.t: Buckwheat with Tuna, Sauerkraut & Cherry Tomatoes
i: 1 can (130-150 g) tuna in its own juice (no oil)
Fresh herbs (parsley, dill, or arugula) - to taste
A few drops of lemon juice
p: Cook the buckwheat: rinse it well, add water (1 part buckwheat to 2 parts water), and cook until tender (15-20 minutes).
Prepare the veggies: halve the cherry tomatoes and chop the herbs.
Combine: mix the cooked buckwheat with tuna, tomatoes, and herbs in a large bowl.
Season: add olive oil, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and paprika.
Serve: with a portion of sauerkraut on the side or on top.

recipes.t: Stuffed Sweet Potatoes with Chicken, Peas, Cherry Tomatoes & Parmesan
i: 200 g cooked chicken breast (grilled or baked, diced)
Salt, black pepper, and paprika - to taste
Optional: a pinch of garlic powder or Italian herbs
p: Bake the sweet potatoes
Preheat the oven to 200°C. Wash and cut each sweet potato in half lengthwise. Place on a baking tray, brush lightly with olive oil, and bake for 25-30 minutes, until soft.
Prepare the filling
While the sweet potatoes bake, heat a small pan. Add the diced chicken, peas, and tomatoes. Season with salt, pepper, and herbs. Warm everything together for 3-5 minutes.
Assemble
When the sweet potatoes are ready, scoop out a bit of the inside (make a small hollow) and mix it into the chicken filling. Then spoon the mixture back into the potato halves.
Top and finish
Sprinkle with Parmesan and return to the oven for 5 minutes, until the cheese melts.

i: 200 ml skim milk or water (or half and half)
1 tbsp. honey cornflakes or similar flakes (for crunch)
p: Prepare the oatmeal: Combine the oatmeal and milk in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 5-7 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Assemble the bowl: Pour the oatmeal into a bowl, top with banana and kiwi slices.
Sprinkle honey flakes on top and drizzle with a little honey if you like extra sweetness.

recipes.t: Rice Cakes with Avocado, Eggs and Light Salad
i: Handful of salad mix (arugula, spinach or lettuce)
Salt, black pepper and lemon juice - to taste
p: Prepare the avocado base: Mash the avocado with a fork, season with salt, pepper and a few drops of lemon juice.
Prepare the eggs: Boil or poach (soft or hard, whichever you prefer).
Assemble the rice cakes
Spread the avocado puree between the rice cakes, then top with the eggs (whole or sliced).
Add a light salad
Toss lettuce and cherry tomatoes with a little olive oil and serve on their own - or sprinkle some of the greens directly on top of the rice cakes.

i: Optional: a cup of black coffee and a glass of orange juice
p: Scramble the eggs
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat olive oil or butter in a pan over medium heat.
Add the eggs and cook, stirring gently, until soft and creamy.
Toast the bread
Toast the bread slice until golden brown.
Prepare the avocado
Mash the avocado with a fork.
Season with a bit of salt, pepper, and lemon juice if desired.
Spread it over the toast.
Add the prosciutto
Place the prosciutto slices on top of the avocado toast.
Serve
Arrange scrambled eggs, baby corn, and fresh spinach on the plate.
Serve with coffee and orange juice.

recipes.t: Protein Chia Yogurt Bowl with Blueberries and Granola
i: 120 ml unsweetened almond milk (or any plant-based milk)
Optional: a few drops of vanilla extract
p: Prepare chia pudding
In the evening or at least 2 hours before breakfast, mix chia seeds with almond milk and a few drops of vanilla extract. Stir well and leave in the fridge to thicken.
Assemble the bowl
In the morning, spoon the chia pudding into a bowl. Add Greek yogurt on top.
Add toppings
Arrange blueberries, granola, and pumpkin seeds on top of the yogurt.
Serve with
A glass of warm or room-temperature water with lemon for gentle morning hydration.
Nutrition benefits
High in protein and fiber keeps you full longer
Low in sugar
Rich in omega-3 fatty acids, antioxidants, and probiotics
Supports digestion and weight management

recipes.t: Oatmeal Breakfast with Berries, Banana, and Peach
i: A small handful of berries (e.g., blueberries, raspberries, or strawberries)
Optional: 1 tsp honey or maple syrup, cinnamon to taste
p: In a small pot, combine the oats and milk.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for about 5-7 minutes, until the oats are soft and creamy.
Transfer the oatmeal to a bowl.
Top with sliced banana, peach, and berries.
Add a drizzle of honey or sprinkle of cinnamon if desired.

recipes.t: Lunch Bowl with Grilled Chicken, Roasted Veggies & Arugula
i: Fresh dill or parsley - 5 g (for garnish)
p: Prepare the ingredients
Rinse and pat dry the chicken breasts (400 g).
Marinate with 10 g olive oil, 5 g lemon juice, salt, pepper, and Italian herbs for about 15-20 minutes.
Wash 200 g baby potatoes and cut them in halves.
Slice 200 g cherry tomatoes and 40 g red onion thinly.
Roast the vegetables
Preheat the oven to 200 °C.
Place the potatoes on a baking tray, drizzle with 5 g olive oil, season with salt and pepper, and roast for 15 minutes.
Then add the tomatoes and roast together for another 10-12 minutes, until soft and golden.
Cook the chicken
Grill or pan-fry the marinated chicken breasts for 5-6 minutes per side, until fully cooked (internal temperature ~75 °C).
Let rest for 2-3 minutes, then slice.
Assemble the bowls
Divide 60 g arugula and 40 g red onion between two plates.
Add roasted potatoes, tomatoes, and sliced chicken.
Top with 15 g capers and 5 g fresh herbs.
Drizzle with the remaining 5 g olive oil before serving.

recipes.t: Lunch Bowl with Fish, Roasted Veggies & Arugula
i: White fish fillet (cod, hake, or tilapia) - 350-400 g
p: Prepare the fish
Rinse and pat dry 400 g white fish fillet.
Rub with 1/2 tbsp olive oil (5 g), lemon juice, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and herbs.
Let it marinate for 10-15 minutes.
Roast the vegetables
Preheat oven to 200°C.
Cut 200 g baby potatoes in halves.
Place potatoes on a tray, drizzle with 1/2 tbsp olive oil (5 g), season with salt and pepper.
Roast for 15 minutes.
Add 200 g cherry tomatoes and roast together for another 10-12 minutes.
Cook the fish
Heat a non-stick pan with 10 g olive oil.
Sear fish for 3-4 minutes per side, until golden and flaky.
Assemble the bowls
Divide 60 g arugula and 40 g red onion between two plates.
Add roasted potatoes, cherry tomatoes, and fish.
Top with 15 g capers and 5 g chopped herbs.
Drizzle with a few drops of lemon juice before serving.

i: Erythritol or stevia - to taste (about 1-2 tsp)
p: In a bowl, mix the cottage cheese, egg, oat flour, yogurt, sweetener, and vanilla.
Blend until smooth (a hand blender works great).
Pour the mixture into a baking dish lined with parchment paper or lightly greased.
Bake at 180°C for about 30-35 minutes, until lightly golden.
Let it cool completely - it will become firmer.
Serve with a spoon of yogurt, banana slices, and chopped nuts on top.

i: 1 slice of whole grain or rye bread
Salt and black pepper to taste
p: Toast the bread lightly and spread the cream cheese evenly on top.
Add avocado slices over the cream cheese and sprinkle with pine nuts.
Fry the egg in a pan with a little oil until the yolk is cooked to your liking. Season with salt and black pepper.
Arrange on a plate: place the toast, fried egg, arugula, cherry tomatoes, blueberries, and cheese slices.
Optionally drizzle a bit of olive oil over the arugula.

i: 200 g spinach tortellini (fresh or whole-grain if available)
30 g fresh spinach (optional - for extra fiber)
100 ml low-fat cream or Greek yogurt (2-5%)
Salt and black pepper to taste
2 boiled or poached eggs (1 per serving)
1 medium fruit (apple, orange, or kiwi - 1/2 per serving)
p: Cook the tortellini according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a small pan, heat olive oil and sauté garlic for 1 minute.
Add spinach (if using) and cook until wilted. Stir in the cream or Greek yogurt and season with salt and pepper.
Mix in the tortellini and heat for another 1-2 minutes. Sprinkle a little Parmesan if desired.
Serve each portion with one boiled or poached egg on the side.
Enjoy a piece of fruit (like half an apple or orange) 15-20 minutes after your meal for a light, balanced finish.

recipes.t: Egg & Ham Toast + Peanut Butter & Banana Toast
i: 1 slice of whole-grain or rye bread
1-2 slices of lean turkey or ham
A handful of arugula or spinach
1 tsp light cream cheese or hummus
Salt, black pepper, paprika - to taste
p: Toast the bread in a toaster or on a dry pan.
Spread with cream cheese or hummus.
Add arugula, turkey slices, and boiled egg rounds on top.
Sprinkle with your favorite spices.
Toast #2 - Sweet & Nutritious
1 slice of whole-grain bread
1 tbsp natural peanut butter
1/2 banana, sliced
A sprinkle of coconut flakes or chia seeds
Toast the bread.
Spread peanut butter evenly.
Top with banana slices and sprinkle with coconut or chia seeds.
Drink: Coffee or Latte (Sugar-Free)
Use plant-based or low-fat milk
Add a bit of cinnamon or vanilla extract for extra flavor

i: 150 g uncooked rice (preferably brown or jasmine)
250 g chicken breast, cut into small cubes
300 g mixed vegetables (broccoli, carrots, bell pepper, peas - fresh or frozen)
1 tbsp olive oil or avocado oil
Salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and herbs (oregano, basil, or paprika) - to taste
Optional: a squeeze of lemon juice or a few drops of soy sauce for flavor
p: Cook the rice according to package instructions until soft and fluffy.
Prepare the chicken
Heat olive oil in a non-stick pan.
Add chicken cubes, season with salt, pepper, and spices.
Cook for 6-8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden and fully cooked.
Add vegetables
In the same pan, add the mixed vegetables (they can be frozen).
Cover and let them simmer for 7-10 minutes until soft but not overcooked.
Combine everything
Mix chicken with the vegetables or serve them side by side.
Add a little lemon juice or soy sauce for extra flavor.

recipes.t: Mashed Potatoes with Chickpea Meatballs & Light Sauce
i: 1 egg (or 1 tbsp flaxseed + 2 tbsp water for vegan option)
Salt, black pepper, paprika, herbs - to taste
1 tsp olive oil (for baking or frying)
p: Mash the chickpeas with a fork or blend in a food processor until smooth but still slightly textured.
Add onion, garlic, egg, flour, and spices - mix well.
Form small balls and bake in the oven (180°C / 180°C, ~20 min) or cook in a pan until golden brown.
Ingredients for the Mashed Potatoes
3 medium potatoes
1 tbsp light butter or olive oil
2-3 tbsp warm milk (plant-based or low-fat)
Salt and pepper to taste
Boil potatoes until soft, then mash.
Add milk and butter, season to taste, and mix until creamy.
Light Tomato Sauce
1 tsp olive oil
1/2 onion, finely chopped
1 small can (200-250 ml) crushed tomatoes or tomato passata
Salt, pepper, oregano, basil - to taste
Sauté onion in olive oil until soft.
Add tomatoes and spices, simmer for 10 minutes until thickened.
Add the chickpea balls and let them soak in the sauce for 5-7 minutes.

i: 2 tbsp oat flour (or finely ground oats)
1/2 tsp olive oil or coconut oil
Sweetener or a few drops of vanilla extract (optional)
1/2 tsp honey or any natural sweetener
A few drops of vanilla extract
Optional: a few berries for topping
p: In a bowl, whisk the egg, milk, oat flour, salt, and oil until smooth.
Heat a non-stick pan and pour a thin layer of batter - cook 1-2 minutes per side until golden.
In another bowl, mix the cottage cheese with honey and vanilla.
Spread the filling on the crepe and roll or fold it.
Serve with fresh berries or a drizzle of Greek yogurt if you like.

i: 1 slice of whole-grain or seeded bread
A pinch of paprika or chili flakes (for topping)
Optional: a drizzle of olive oil or lemon juice
p: Toast the bread until golden and crispy.
Mash the avocado in a small bowl with a fork. Add a little salt, pepper, and lemon juice if desired.
Poach the egg
Bring a small pot of water to a gentle simmer.
Add vinegar.
Crack the egg into a cup and carefully slide it into the water.
Cook for about 3 minutes, then remove with a slotted spoon.
Assemble
Spread avocado on the toast.
Add cottage cheese, tomato slices, and spinach.
Top with the poached egg.
Finish
Sprinkle with paprika or chili flakes and a pinch of salt.
Drizzle with olive oil if desired.

i: 40 g creamy dressing or yogurt sauce
p: Place 60 g of mixed salad greens into a bowl.
Add 120 g of chopped cucumber on one side.
Add 70 g of sweet corn next to it.
Chop the hard-boiled egg and place 50 g of it into the bowl.
Add 80 g of drained tuna.
Pour 40 g of dressing over the center.
Mix everything together or enjoy as a layered bowl.

i: 150 g lettuce (romaine, iceberg or leaf lettuce)
Optional: lemon juice or light dressing
p: Cook the rice
Rinse and cook 200 g of brown rice according to package instructions.
Prepare the chicken
Cut chicken breast into medium pieces.
Heat olive oil in a pan.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Cook for 8-10 minutes until golden and fully done.
Assemble the salad
Place mixed greens and lettuce into two bowls.
Add sliced mini peppers and cherry tomatoes.
Add rice and chicken
Divide cooked rice and grilled chicken evenly between the two bowls.
Optional
Add lemon juice or your favorite light dressing on top.

recipes.t: Vegetable Casserole with Broccoli, Tomatoes & Zucchini
i: Salt and black pepper to taste
Optional spices: oregano, basil, garlic powder, paprika
p: Prepare the vegetables
Cut broccoli into small florets.
Slice the tomatoes.
Cut the zucchini into half-moons or small cubes.
Slice the onion and sweet pepper.
Slightly pre-cook the broccoli
Boil or steam for 2-3 minutes, just until slightly softened.
Assemble the casserole
Lightly grease a baking dish with olive oil.
Add broccoli, tomatoes, zucchini, onion, and pepper.
Season with salt, pepper, and any optional herbs.
Sprinkle half of the grated cheese over the vegetables.
Prepare the egg mixture
In a bowl, whisk together the eggs and milk (or cream).
Add a pinch of salt and pepper.
Pour the mixture evenly over the vegetables.
Bake
Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, until the top is set and lightly golden.
Add the remaining cheese 5 minutes before the end of baking for a melting crust.

i: Optional chopped vegetables (bell pepper, tomato) - 20 g
p: Make the omelette
Whisk eggs with milk, salt, and pepper.
Add optional vegetables.
Cook on medium heat until firm, then fold.
Prepare the toast
Lightly toast the bread.
Spread peanut butter.
Add banana slices and sprinkle coconut.
Assemble the plate
Place the omelette.
Add jamón.
Add lettuce, cucumber, and corn.
Serve with your coffee.

i: Diced tomato or bell pepper - 50 g
Whole-grain or seed bread - 2 slices (≈60-70 g)
Salt and black pepper - to taste
p: Cook the asparagus (fresh or frozen)
Heat a pan with 5 g olive oil.
Add 120-150 g asparagus (frozen can go straight to the pan).
Sauté for 4-6 minutes until tender but slightly crisp.
Season with salt and pepper.
Cook the eggs
In the same pan, sauté 50 g diced tomato or bell pepper for 1 minute.
Crack 2 eggs over the vegetables.
Season with salt and pepper.
Cook until desired doneness.
Sprinkle with 10-15 g grated cheese (optional).
Prepare the sides
Slice 80-90 g avocado and season lightly.
Prepare 60-80 g smoked salmon.
Toast 2 slices (60-70 g) whole-grain bread.
Assemble the plate
Arrange asparagus, eggs, avocado, salmon, and toasted bread beautifully on a plate.

recipes.t: Buckwheat + Chicken Patties + Fresh Cabbage Salad
i: Chicken breast or minced chicken - 300 g
Paprika or your favorite spices - 1/2 tsp
A little chopped dill or parsley (optional)
Olive oil - 1-2 tsp (optional, for weight loss you can skip)
p: Make the chicken patties
Blend chicken and onion or use ready minced chicken.
Add egg, salt, pepper, spices, and greens.
Form small patties with wet hands.
Cook in one of the weight-loss-friendly ways
Pan, no oil: on a non-stick pan for 4-5 min per side.
Baked: 180°C for 20-25 min.
Steamed: 20 minutes.
(baked or braised)
Cook the buckwheat
Rinse the buckwheat.
Bring 300 ml water to a boil, add buckwheat and a pinch of salt.
Simmer on low heat for 15 minutes until water is absorbed.
Leave covered for 5 minutes to fluff.
Prepare the salad
Thinly slice cabbage and grate the carrot.
Add salt and lightly massage by hand to soften.
Add lemon juice, dill, and optional 1-2 tsp olive oil.
Mix.
Assemble the plate
Divide the buckwheat into 2 servings.
Add 2-3 chicken patties to each plate.
Add a generous portion of fresh cabbage salad.
Top with a little chopped greens.

recipes.t: Stuffed Peppers with Chicken, Zucchini & Cheese
i: Minced chicken or finely chopped chicken breast - 250 g
A little dried oregano or basil - optional
Light cheese (mozzarella light, suluguni light, or low-fat hard cheese) - 40-50 g
A few sprays of olive oil or 1 tsp
p: Prepare the vegetables
Cut the bell peppers in half and remove seeds.
Grate the zucchini on a coarse grater.
Finely chop the onion.
(Optional) Add 1 minced garlic clove.
Make the filling
Mix in a bowl
250 g chicken
150 g grated zucchini
60 g onion
Salt, pepper, paprika, herbs
Stir well until the mixture becomes even.
Stuff the peppers
Fill each bell pepper half generously.
Sprinkle the tops lightly with 40-50 g grated light cheese.
Bake
Preheat oven to 190°C.
Place peppers on a baking tray.
Bake 25-30 minutes until chicken is fully cooked and cheese is golden.

recipes.t: Chicken Rice Bowl with Broccoli & Seaweed
i: A little olive oil or lemon juice (optional)
p: Cook the chicken
Season the chicken breast with salt, pepper, and any spices you like.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, until golden and fully cooked.
Slice into strips and divide into 2 portions.
Prepare the rice
Cook the rice according to package instructions.
Fluff with a fork.
Season lightly with salt and pepper.
Divide evenly into 2 plates.
Sprinkle chia seeds on top (optional).
Broccoli
Steam for 6-7 minutes
Pan-roast with a little oil until lightly browned.
Split into 2 servings.
Assemble the bowls
On each plate
Rice
Sliced chicken
Broccoli
Seaweed salad
Diced tomato
Optional lemon juice or olive oil

i: 300 g mashed potatoes (prepared with a little water or plant milk)
0-120 g chicken (optional) - a small amount for light protein
Salt and black pepper to taste
p: Mashed potatoes
Boil peeled potatoes until soft.
Mash using a splash of water or plant milk.
Add salt and pepper.
Divide into two portions of about 150 g each.
Sauerkraut
Add 100 g per plate.
Rinse lightly if it's too salty.
Beetroot
Dice boiled or steamed beetroot.
Split into two servings, about 80-100 g per portion.
Optional chicken
Use up to 60 g of chicken per serving, or skip it completely.
Cook in a pan or bake with minimal oil.
Add a small piece to each plate only for light protein.

i: A pinch of dried herbs or seasoning mix
A handful of mixed fresh greens (arugula, spinach, or lettuce)
p: Make the omelet
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper.
Heat butter or oil in a pan over medium heat.
Pour in the eggs and cook until set, folding gently in half.
Sprinkle with herbs or seasoning.
Prepare the toast
Toast the slice of bread.
Spread ricotta on top.
Add tomato slices and season with salt and pepper.
Prepare the greens
Mix the greens, dill, and mint in a bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.
Season lightly and toss.
Serve
Plate the omelet, toast, and greens.
Brew a cup of green tea and serve alongside.
Spoon the yogurt into a bowl and spread it evenly.
Slice the banana and place the slices on top of the yogurt.
Add granola to one side of the bowl.
Sprinkle chia seeds over the yogurt.
Serve immediately and enjoy!

recipes.t: Chicken with Green Beans & Mashed Potatoes
i: 400 g chicken breast, cut into pieces
Salt, pepper, and spices to taste
p: Cook the chicken
Heat the oil in a pan. Add the chicken, season with salt, pepper, and spices.
Cook until browned, then add the green beans and sauté until soft.
Make the mashed potatoes
Peel and boil the potatoes until tender.
Mash with butter, milk, and salt until smooth.
Prepare the sides
Portion out the sauerkraut. Add the optional boiled beets.
Assemble the plates
Divide the chicken with vegetables, mashed potatoes, sauerkraut, and optional beets into two servings.

i: 120 g cucumbers, chopped (if you want to include them)
A handful of fresh parsley (about 10-15 g)
1 tbsp lemon juice or vinegar (about 15 g)
Salt and black pepper to taste
p: Prepare the vegetables
Chop the tomatoes, slice the onion, and chop the cucumbers if using.
Add everything to a large bowl.
Add feta and olives
Gently fold in the cubed feta cheese and sliced black olives.
Add herbs
Roughly chop the parsley and add it to the salad.
Make the dressing
Mix olive oil, lemon juice (or vinegar), salt, pepper, and oregano.
Assemble
Pour the dressing over the salad and gently toss.
Divide into two servings.

recipes.t: Avocado Toast with Eggs, Cherry Tomatoes & Arugula
i: 2 slices of bread (whole-grain or sourdough works great)
Optional: a drizzle of olive oil
Optional: a squeeze of lemon juice
1 nut (e.g., walnut or almond) to place on the plate at the end
p: Toast the bread in a toaster or on a pan.
Prepare the avocado: mash it with a fork, add salt, pepper, and a few drops of lemon juice.
Cook the eggs: soft scrambled eggs work beautifully - light, creamy, and not overcooked.
Assemble: spread the mashed avocado on each toast, top with eggs, sliced cherry tomatoes, and fresh arugula.
Season with a bit more salt and pepper; drizzle with olive oil if you like.
Finish the plate by adding one nut (like a walnut or almond) as a small final touch.
Finish the plate by adding 8-10 nuts (such as walnuts, almonds, or hazelnuts).

recipes.t: Cottage Cheese Bowl with Banana, Walnuts, and Honey
p: Put the cottage cheese into a bowl.
Slice the banana and place it on top.
Add the chopped walnuts.
Drizzle the honey over everything.
Enjoy your healthy breakfast!

recipes.t: Chickpea-Spinach Patties with Rice and Steamed Frozen Vegetables
i: For the chickpea-spinach patties (6-8 small patties)
1 egg (or 1 tbsp flaxseed + 3 tbsp water for vegan version)
Optional: paprika, turmeric, or dried herbs
300-350 g mixed frozen vegetables (broccoli, cauliflower, carrots, romanesco)
p: Make the patties
Mash the chickpeas in a bowl (or blend lightly, leaving some texture).
Add chopped onion, garlic, spinach, salt, pepper, and spices.
Mix in the egg and flour/breadcrumbs until the mixture holds together.
Form small patties with wet hands.
Pan-fry on a lightly oiled pan for 3-4 minutes per side, or bake at 190°C for 15-20 min until golden.
Cook the rice
Rinse the rice under cold water.
Add it to a pot with water and a pinch of salt.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and cook 12-15 minutes.
Turn off the heat and let rest 5 minutes.
Cook the vegetables
Bring a pot of water to a boil.
Add the frozen vegetables and cook 4-6 minutes until tender but not mushy.
Drain and season lightly with salt.
Assemble
Place rice on each plate, add steamed vegetables, then 3-4 patties.
Serve with a drizzle of olive oil, Greek yogurt sauce, or soy sauce if desired.

i: Canned tuna in its own juice - 150-200 g (1 can)
Spinach or mixed salad leaves - 2 large handfuls
Salt and black pepper - to taste
p: Boil the eggs.
Quail eggs: cook for 4 minutes after boiling. Peel and cut in halves.
Prepare the vegetables.
Slice the avocado.
Cut the cherry tomatoes in halves.
Slice the red onion into thin half-rings.
Prepare the tuna.
Drain the liquid and break the tuna into medium pieces.
Assemble the salad.
Divide the salad leaves between two bowls.
Add tomatoes, avocado slices, eggs, tuna, and red onion.
Make the dressing.
Mix olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Drizzle over the salad before serving.

recipes.t: Creamy Oatmeal with Banana, Blueberries & Nuts
p: Add the oats and milk to a small saucepan.
Cook over medium heat for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until creamy.
Transfer the oatmeal to a bowl.
Top with banana, blueberries, and nuts.
Add honey or maple syrup and cinnamon if desired.

i: Greek yogurt or light mayo - 60 g
p: Peel and cube the potatoes. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Mix potatoes, chicken, onion, garlic, olive oil, herbs, salt, and pepper.
Bake at 180°C for 35-40 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
Chop the cabbage and cucumber, add corn and dressing, mix well.
Slice the bell pepper and tomatoes.
Serve everything in bowls, dividing evenly into 2 portions.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add garlic (if using) and cook for 30 seconds.
Add green beans and bell pepper, sauté for 3-4 minutes.
Add peas and corn, cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked rice, season with salt and pepper, and mix well.
Cook for 2-3 minutes until everything is heated through.
Divide into 2 portions and serve warm

recipes.t: Breakfast Plate with Avocado, Egg & Cheese
i: 2 slices semi-hard cheese (e.g. Gouda, Edam, or similar)
