A few slices of red bell pepper
Salt and black pepper, to taste
p: Toast the bread slices until golden and crisp.
Peel the avocado, slice it, and arrange on one slice of toast. Sprinkle with salt, pepper, and optional seeds or chili flakes.
Place the cheese slices on the second slice of toast.
Peel the hard-boiled egg, cut it in half, and season with salt, pepper, and chili flakes if desired.
Wash the arugula, cherry tomatoes, and bell pepper. Cut the tomatoes in halves.
Arrange the vegetables on the plate alongside the toast and egg.
Serve immediately and enjoy a nutritious, balanced breakfast.

recipes.t: Sweet Potato with Asparagus & Creamy Cheese
i: 120-150 g creamy soft cheese (burrata, ricotta, or cream cheese)
Salt and black pepper, to taste
Sesame seeds or grated hard cheese (optional, for topping)
p: Preheat the oven to 200°C / 200°C.
Wash the sweet potatoes, pierce them with a fork, and bake whole for 40-50 minutes until soft inside.
Trim the asparagus. Toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast on a baking tray for 12-15 minutes until tender.
Once the sweet potatoes are ready, slice them lengthwise and gently mash the inside with a fork.
Season the sweet potato flesh with salt, pepper, and optional smoked paprika or chili flakes.
Top each sweet potato with creamy cheese and roasted asparagus.
Finish with sesame seeds or a little grated cheese if desired.
Serve warm as a balanced, satisfying lunch.

recipes.t: Chicken Rice Bowl with Fresh Salad
i: 10 g lemon juice or balsamic vinegar
p: Cook the rice in salted water until tender.
Mix chicken with oil, spices, salt, and pepper.
Pan-fry the chicken over medium heat for 6-8 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Divide spinach, cucumber, and tomatoes between bowls.
Add rice and chicken.
Top with mixed seeds and drizzle with dressing if using.

i: Salt and black pepper, to taste
p: Toast the whole-grain bread until golden.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Crack 2 eggs into the pan and fry them to your liking (sunny-side up or over-easy). Season with salt and pepper.
Arrange the salad greens on a plate. Add cucumber, radishes, and chopped tomato. Drizzle lightly with olive oil if desired.
Place the toasted bread on the plate and top it with the fried eggs.
Add the blueberries in a small bowl or directly on the plate.
Serve immediately and enjoy a balanced, fresh breakfast.

recipes.t: Whole-Wheat Spaghetti with Chicken & Cherry Tomatoes
i: Optional: chili flakes or lemon juice
p: Cook the pasta
Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente. Reserve a little pasta water and drain.
Cook the chicken
Heat olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add chicken, season with salt and pepper, and cook for 5-6 minutes until fully cooked.
Make the sauce
Add garlic to the pan and cook for 30 seconds.
Add cherry tomatoes and herbs, cook until tomatoes soften.
Combine
Add spaghetti and a little pasta water to the pan. Toss gently.
Finish
Adjust seasoning, add chili flakes or lemon if desired.
Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve.

i: A handful of fresh berries (blueberries, blackberries or mixed berries)
Optional: a little honey or cinnamon (optional, not necessary)
p: Add cottage cheese to a bowl.
Spoon Greek yogurt on top.
Add fresh berries.
Mix slightly or eat as layers.

recipes.t: Quinoa Bowl with Eggs, Broccoli & Pickled Cucumbers
i: 1 tsp mixed seeds (sesame, pumpkin or sunflower seeds)
Optional: lemon juice or a little mustar
p: Cook the quinoa
Rinse quinoa well. Cook in salted water according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Cook the eggs
Boil eggs for 6-7 minutes for a soft yolk or longer if you prefer them firm. Peel and cut in half.
Prepare the broccoli
Steam or lightly pan-fry broccoli with a little olive oil until tender but still bright green.
Prepare the cucumbers
Slice the pickled cucumbers. No extra seasoning is needed because they already add flavor.
Assemble the bowls
Divide quinoa between two bowls.
Add broccoli, eggs, and pickled cucumbers.
Sprinkle with seeds, add pepper, and a few drops of olive oil if needed.

i: Lettuce leaves or iceberg - 1 large handful
Lemon juice or apple cider vinegar - 1 tbsp
p: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add chickpeas, paprika, garlic, salt, and pepper. Sauté for 5-7 minutes until warm and slightly golden.
Remove from heat and mix in the grated carrots.
Add lettuce leaves, drizzle with lemon juice or vinegar, and gently toss.
Sprinkle with seeds if using and serve warm.

recipes.t: Avocado Toast with Soft-Boiled Eggs, Nuts & Black Coffee / Green Tea
i: 2 slices of whole-grain or sourdough bread
Black pepper or chili flakes, to taste
Black coffee or green tea, without sugar
p: Toast the bread slices until golden and crispy.
Bring water to a boil, gently add the eggs, and cook for about 6-7 minutes for a soft-boiled center.
While the eggs are cooking, mash the avocado in a bowl with a pinch of salt and a few drops of lemon juice.
Spread the avocado evenly over the toasted bread.
Peel the eggs, cut them in half, and place on top of the avocado toast.
Season with black pepper or chili flakes.
Serve with 8-10 nuts on the side, eaten after the avocado toast.
Enjoy your breakfast with a cup of black coffee or green tea.

i: Salt and black pepper - to taste
p: Rinse the quinoa well and cook it in a 1:2 ratio (quinoa to water) until tender.
Chop all vegetables into large pieces. Place them on a baking tray, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt, pepper, and herbs.
Roast at 180°C for 20-25 minutes until the vegetables are soft and lightly golden.
Divide the cooked quinoa between two bowls and top with the roasted vegetables.
Fruit (after lunch)
1 medium apple or
1 pear or
140 g of berries

recipes.t: Cabbage Salad with Baked Chicken Fillet
i: Lemon juice or apple cider vinegar - to taste
Salt and black pepper - to taste
Paprika, garlic powder, black pepper - to taste
Paprika, cumin, black pepper - to taste
p: Prepare the salad
In a large bowl, combine shredded cabbage and sliced cucumber. Add olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Mix well and set aside.
Chicken option
Season the chicken fillet with olive oil and spices. Bake at 180°C for 20-25 minutes until fully cooked. Slice before serving.
Chickpea option
Toss the chickpeas with olive oil and spices. Bake at 180°C for 15-20 minutes until slightly crispy.
Divide the cabbage salad between two plates and add the baked chicken slices or roasted chickpeas on the side.

recipes.t: Oatmeal with Fruit, Nuts & Rice Cake with Peanut Butter
p: Cook the oats with water or plant-based milk over medium heat for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Slice the banana and add it to the oatmeal. Sprinkle with cinnamon if desired.
Top the oatmeal with mixed nuts.
Serve with one rice cake spread with peanut butter on the side.

recipes.t: Boiled Eggs with Crispbread, Jamón & Fresh Salad
i: Jamón (or other cured ham) - 2-3 thin slices
Salt and black pepper - to taste
p: Boil the eggs in hot water for 8-9 minutes until hard-boiled. Cool, peel, and cut in half.
Place the crispbread on a plate and top with slices of jamón.
Arrange arugula, mixed salad greens, and cherry tomatoes on the side.
Season the eggs and salad with salt and black pepper. Add a few drops of olive oil if desired.

recipes.t: Pasta with Tuna & Fresh Mixed Salad
i: Salt and black pepper - to taste
p: Cook the pasta in salted water according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a pan, lightly sauté the garlic, add tuna and halved cherry tomatoes. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked pasta, season with salt, pepper, and herbs. Mix gently.
In a bowl, combine salad greens and sliced cucumber. Dress with lemon juice, olive oil, and a pinch of salt.
Divide the pasta and salad evenly between two plates.

recipes.t: Dinner Salad with Spinach, Mozzarella & Jamón
i: Balsamic vinegar or balsamic glaze - 1-2 tsp
Salt and black pepper - to taste
Roasted pumpkin seeds or pine nuts - 1 tsp
p: Wash and dry the spinach. Place it in a large salad bowl.
Cut the cherry tomatoes in halves and add to the spinach.
Tear or slice the mozzarella into small pieces and add to the salad.
Tear the jamón into thin strips and place on top.
Add cucumber, seeds, or basil if using.

i: 200 g mixed berries (strawberries, blueberries, raspberries) or other fruit of choice
p: Divide the cottage cheese evenly between two bowls.
Add the protein powder and mix well until smooth.
Top with fresh fruit.
Drizzle with honey and sprinkle with nuts if desired.
Serve immediately.

recipes.t: Cottage Cheese Plate with Avocado Toast & Fruit
p: In a bowl, combine the cottage cheese and Greek yogurt.
Top with sliced strawberries, peach, apricot, and chopped pecans.
Toast the bread and top it with sliced avocado. Season with salt, black pepper, and a squeeze of lemon juice if desired.
Serve the cottage cheese bowl with the avocado toast.

recipes.t: Salmon or Chicken with Baby Potatoes & Creamy Cabbage Salad
i: 300 g salmon fillet (or 300 g chicken breast, if preferred)
p: Boil the baby potatoes until tender. Season with salt and fresh dill.
Season the salmon (or chicken) with salt and pepper, then pan-sear or bake until fully cooked.
In a bowl, combine the cabbage, cucumber, green onions, and dill.
Mix the Greek yogurt with Dijon mustard, then toss with the salad.
Divide everything evenly between two plates and serve.

recipes.t: Green Pasta with Tuna & Crispy Chickpeas
i: 1 can tuna in water, drained (160 g)
p: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
Toss the chickpeas with olive oil, paprika, salt, and pepper. Roast or air-fry at 200°C for 15-20 minutes until crispy.
Blend the spinach, Greek yogurt, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Mix the cooked pasta with the green sauce.
Divide between two bowls and top with tuna, sliced avocado, crispy chickpeas, and sesame seeds.

recipes.t: Boiled Eggs with Fresh Vegetables & Berries
i: 100 g mixed berries (strawberries, blueberries, raspberries, or any berries you like)
p: Boil the eggs to your preferred doneness, peel, and serve whole or sliced.
Chop the tomatoes and cucumber, season with salt and black pepper.
Add the fresh berries on the side for a naturally sweet finish.

i: Optional: 1 tsp honey or a few drops of vanilla extract
p: Blend the Greek yogurt with the frozen strawberries until smooth and creamy.
Transfer to a bowl.
Top with the granola.
Enjoy immediately!

recipes.t: Spinach Omelet + Tuna Toast and Berries
i: 1 slice of whole-grain or rye bread
50-60 g tuna in its own juice
100 g berries - , raspberries, blueberries, or a mix
p: Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper.
Lightly sauté the spinach in a pan with 1 tsp of olive oil.
Pour the eggs over the spinach and cook the omelet over medium heat until done.
Toast the bread and top it with tuna.
Slice the cucumber, cherry tomatoes, and bell pepper.
Tea or coffee
Approximate calories: 450-500 kcal.
Cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
Heat the olive oil in a pan, add the garlic and cherry tomatoes, and cook for a few minutes.
Add the tomato sauce, salt and pepper, and simmer for 5-7 minutes.
Add the cooked pasta and mix everything together. You can add a little pasta water to make the sauce creamier.
Remove from the heat and add the mozzarella and fresh basil.
Divide the finished pasta into 2 equal portions - one for today and one for tomorrow.
Snack after lunch

i: 400 g mixed salad vegetables (cucumber, tomatoes, lettuce, bell pepper)
or 400 g fresh asparagus as an alternative to the salad
Salt, pepper and herbs to taste
p: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Wash and cut the potatoes into wedges. Season with salt, pepper and herbs, add half of the olive oil and bake for 30-35 minutes, until golden and tender.
Season the salmon with salt, pepper and lemon juice. Bake for 12-15 minutes, depending on the thickness.
Prepare the salad by chopping the vegetables and mixing them with the remaining olive oil and a little lemon juice.
Alternatively, you can have fresh asparagus instead of the salad. Simply boil or steam the asparagus for a few minutes until tender.
Mix the Greek yogurt with lemon juice, salt and herbs to make a simple sauce.
Divide everything into 2 equal portions - one for today and one for tomorrow.
If you don't want fish, you can replace the salmon with 240 g chicken breast (120 g per serving). Season it with salt, pepper and herbs and bake or grill until fully cooked.

recipes.t: Cheese Bowl with Banana, Chia Seeds & Walnuts + Tea
p: Mix the cottage cheese with the natural yogurt in a bowl.
Slice the banana and arrange it on top.
Add the chia seeds and chopped walnuts.
Serve with a cup of tea

recipes.t: Bowl with Chickpeas, Quinoa and Vegetables
p: If using canned chickpeas - rinse and dry well.
Boil the quinoa in advance.
Chop the cucumber, pepper, tomatoes and red onion.
Mix vegetables, quinoa, chickpeas, herbs and olives.
Add feta.
Season with lemon juice and 10 g of olive oil for the entire bowl.
Divide into 2 equal portions.
Eat one portion today, leave the second for the next day.

recipes.t: Sweet Potato with Chickpeas, Hummus and Feta
p: Wash the sweet potato well, cut in half or into large slices.
Sprinkle with paprika, salt, pepper and brush with a small amount of olive oil.
Bake at 200°C for about 30-40 minutes, until soft.
Drain the chickpeas, add paprika and spices and bake with the sweet potato for the last 15-20 minutes.
Spread hummus, chickpeas, and thinly sliced ​​red onion over the finished sweet potato.
Top with feta and lots of fresh herbs.
Divide into 2 portions.

i: tuna in its own juice - ~100 g
p: Boil the eggs until hard-boiled, cool and cut into pieces.
Mash the avocado with a fork and add a little lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Toast the bread in a toaster or on a dry pan.
Spread the mashed avocado over the toast and top with tuna.
Serve with boiled eggs, arugula and tomatoes.
Cook the eggs in a non-stick pan without oil or with a minimal amount. Serve with avocado, cherry tomatoes, greens and toasted whole-grain bread. Sprinkle with Parmesan.
Combine the chickpeas, cucumber, red onion and herbs. Add feta on top and dress with lemon juice and olive oil.
Simply combine everything in a bowl and enjoy.

i: 200 g broccoli, zucchini or green beans
p: Cook the rice.
Season the chicken with paprika, garlic, salt and pepper. Cook in a non-stick pan or bake until fully cooked.
Steam or roast the vegetables.
Mix Greek yogurt with lemon juice, garlic and spices to make a light sauce.
Serve the rice with chicken and vegetables, topped with the yogurt sauce.
